Source-grounded requirements and open-rule register
MD
Source-grounded requirements and open-rule register

This note grounds the current prototype in the materials already supplied in this workspace. It does not treat the MO-IT107 design set as an automatic replacement for any MO-IT110 milestone requirement.

Project decisions already made
Start a fresh project; there is no personal MS1 implementation to extend.
Use Java for the backend and payroll logic, with an HTML/CSS browser interface instead of Swing.
Use Firebase if feasible; no Firebase project or credentials have been created/connected yet.
Use the other teams' submissions selectively as pattern references, not as a full project to submit.
Keep synthetic data only; never use the uploaded inventory CSV as payroll data.
Do not invent payroll formulas, current statutory rates, or expected payroll outputs.
The UI should be professional, restrained, and non-game-like, using permitted/credited code selectively.
Supplied source set
uploads/MO-IT107 - 2nd Milestone_ Database Design for the MotorPH Payroll System H2101 TORRES, J.D..pdf
uploads/MO-IT107 Homework_ Data Dictionary for MotorPH Payroll System Database H2101 Torres, J.D..pdf
uploads/MO-IT107 Homework_ Data Flow Diagram of MotorPH Payroll System H2101 Torres, J.D..pdf
uploads/MotorPH_Payroll_System_Full_Synthesis.md — detailed text reconstruction of those three PDFs.
MO-IT110 modules/requirements were reviewed earlier and summarized in repo_review/submission-comprehensive-report.md; the readable project-level conclusion is that the modules teach the Java/OOP design-to-implementation progression, but do not provide a complete payroll formula oracle.
repo_review/submission-comprehensive-report.md — repository tests, module links, scope cautions, and limitations for the nine reference submissions.
Facts used in the current slice
Employee directory

The MO-IT107 Data Dictionary describes Employee identity/status and links to Address, Position, Department, Government, and Supervisor. The exact direct-vs-derived relationships differ between that dictionary, Database Design prose, and the ERD. Therefore the current UI uses only a small display projection (ID, name, department, role, location, status) with fully synthetic records. It does not claim to implement the full Employee table or decide the disputed relationships. Government identifiers and other PII are intentionally absent.

Attendance read-only model

The supplied Data Dictionary lists these Attendance fields:

attendanceID — integer primary key;
scheduleID — foreign key;
date — date, unique in combination with scheduleID;
timeIn and timeOut — time values, with the source check timeIn <= timeOut;
dayType — enum, with members not specified.

The prototype maps these to AttendanceRecord and validates positive synthetic identifiers, required values, timeIn <= timeOut, and unique (scheduleID, date) entries. A minimal employee-to-schedule mapping allows records to be viewed for an employee. The screen provides read-only inclusive date filtering; inclusive filtering is a software behavior of this prototype, not a claimed payroll policy. dayType is shown as DEMO, not as an official enum value. No work hours, overtime, paid leave, undertime, or pay values are derived.

The database-design PDF also describes attendance as tied to Schedule and the DFD routes attendance through Schedule and Time Tracking, then Timesheet Validation. The exact source/import mechanism and MS2 workflow are not asserted by this read-only fixture.

Payroll and payslip fields

The source set names payroll components and storage fields, including:

Payroll: employee, wage/rebate/summary IDs, month, PTO maximum, hourly/daily/monthly rates, net pay;
Payslip: payroll ID, period start/end, regular/overtime/holiday-overtime/PTO/undertime hours, worked days/holidays/rest days, gross income;
Earnings: overtime/PTO/holiday/rest-day pay, subsidies/stipends, other incentives, total benefits;
Deductibles, Other Transactions, Government Deductibles, Contributions, Government Tally, and Summary for deduction and contribution amounts/totals.

The DFD labels Timesheet Validation, Leave Monetisation, Wage and Adjustments, Government Deductibles, Basic Payroll Computation, Payslip Generation & Distribution, and Monthly Summary Compilation. These descriptions establish the concept names and broad flow, not their exact computation.

Unresolved source conflicts kept open

The PDFs disagree on several schema details. The prototype has not chosen a definitive production schema for these:

Schedule.restDay SET versus Schedule.restDayID plus a separate Rest Day table;
direct Employee departmentID / governmentID versus deriving department via Position and linking Government via Government.employeeID;
Address region stored directly versus derived through City;
presence of Supervisor.departmentID;
presence of Leave.scheduleID;
key/version fields for Rates and Government Tally;
some Holiday uniqueness and relationship-matrix cardinalities.

See Sections 16 and 17 of the full synthesis for the complete discrepancies.

Payroll-rule status

The source documents do not supply the arithmetic formula or current effective values for gross pay, salary conversion, overtime, holiday/rest-day rates, undertime, paid leave, leave monetisation, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, withholding tax, deductions, net pay, or rounding. They also do not provide an authoritative worked payslip example. The payroll screen therefore remains intentionally disabled. The nine GitHub submissions' formulas/tests are comparison evidence only, not a policy authority.

Scope boundary

MO-IT107's DFD/database design is broad (five actors; employee management, payroll processing, and archival; PII approval intent; many database tables). The current project begins as a narrow web-based Java/OOP slice. Do not add every actor, all tables, two-person PII workflow, monthly reports, or archive deletion unless the active MO-IT110 milestone explicitly requires it. Keep such items traceable to the source and clearly labelled reference-only until scope is confirmed.

ms2-firebase-task-breakdown.md

Prototype API contract
MD
Prototype API contract

All routes are same-origin JSON endpoints. Current records are in-memory synthetic fixtures; these endpoints are unauthenticated and must not be used with real data.

Health

GET /api/health

JSON
{"status":"ok","mode":"synthetic-demo"}
Employee directory

GET /api/employees

GET /api/employees?q=finance

JSON
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "DEMO-002",
      "name": "Eli Santos",
      "department": "Finance",
      "role": "Payroll Associate",
      "location": "Taguig",
      "status": "Active"
    }
  ],
  "total": 3,
  "matched": 1
}

Search is case-insensitive across the displayed employee fields. total is the full synthetic directory size; matched is the number returned.

GET /api/employees/{employeeId}

Returns {"item": {...}} or 404 {"error":"Employee not found"}.

Raw attendance

GET /api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001

Optional ISO date filters: from=YYYY-MM-DD and/or to=YYYY-MM-DD. If both are supplied, from must be on or before to; filtering is inclusive. employeeId is required.

JSON
{
  "items": [
    {
      "attendanceId": 5001,
      "scheduleId": 101,
      "date": "2026-10-01",
      "timeIn": "08:01",
      "timeOut": "17:00",
      "dayType": "DEMO"
    }
  ],
  "count": 1,
  "hoursCalculated": false
}

Possible errors: 400 for a missing employee ID, invalid date syntax, or reversed range; 404 for an unknown employee. This endpoint returns raw times only. It intentionally does not derive hours or pay.

Planned constraints
No write routes exist yet.
Do not add employee/attendance writes until authentication, data ownership, validation, and Firestore Security Rules are designed and tested.
When Firebase is connected, preserve the Java EmployeeStore / AttendanceStore service boundaries and do not expose privileged credentials in browser code.

Firebase development setup — MotorPH MS2
MD
Firebase development setup — MotorPH MS2

This guide creates a development Firebase project only for the MotorPH browser app. It does not add payroll data, deploy the app, or open Firestore to the public. The app currently uses synthetic in-memory data; Firebase is not connected yet.

Before you start

Have access to the Google account that should own the development project. Keep this separate from any future production project. Suggested labels:

Project display name: MotorPH MS2 Development
Web app nickname: motorph-ms2-web-dev
Project ID: accept a suitable available ID, e.g. motorph-ms2-dev-<unique-suffix>

Firebase project IDs are identifiers used in URLs/configuration, so write down the exact ID shown by the console. If a name is already taken, Firebase will suggest or require another ID.

Do not add real MotorPH employee or payroll data. Do not generate or share a service-account private key. If the console asks you to enable billing, enter payment details, or upgrade a plan, pause and ask before proceeding.

1. Create the development Firebase project
Open the Firebase Console and sign in with the account that will own the project.
Select Create a project / Add project.
Enter the project display name, for example MotorPH MS2 Development.
If asked about Google Analytics, choose Not now / leave it disabled. Analytics is not needed for this app foundation.
Finish project creation and wait for the project overview page.
Record the exact Project ID. It may differ from the display name.

This project is a container for Firebase services. Creating it does not publish the payroll app or make employee data public.

2. Register a Web App (configuration only)

From the project overview, click the Web icon (</>). If the project already has apps, choose Add app and then Web.

Set the nickname to motorph-ms2-web-dev.

Leave Firebase Hosting unchecked/not configured for now. The current prototype is served by its Java app; hosting that backend is a later deployment decision.

Click Register app.

Firebase will show a JavaScript configuration object. Copy the displayed values to a temporary private note. The relevant values look like:

JavaScript
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "...",
  authDomain: "...",
  projectId: "...",
  appId: "..."
};

The console may display additional values such as storageBucket, messagingSenderId, and measurementId; they are not needed for the first Firestore/Auth slice.

You can return to this config later from Project settings (gear icon) → General → Your apps → this Web App.

A Firebase Web App config/API key identifies the Firebase project/app; it is not a service-account credential. Firebase’s security boundary is Authentication, Firestore Security Rules, and (where needed) App Check—not hiding this web config. Do not use the Firebase key for unrelated Google APIs. See Firebase API key guidance.

3. Create Cloud Firestore safely
In the left navigation, open Build → Firestore Database. In some console layouts it appears under Databases & Storage → Firestore.
Click Create database.
Choose the Standard edition if asked to choose an edition; the app needs ordinary Firestore document storage.
Choose Production mode / locked rules as the starting mode. This denies client reads and writes until explicit rules are added. Do not choose Test mode and do not publish allow read, write: if true.
Choose the database location carefully. For a Taguig/Philippines development app, Singapore (asia-southeast1) is a reasonable nearby option if offered. The Firestore database location cannot be changed after provisioning, and a project may already have a default Google Cloud resource location dependency. Check the displayed location before clicking Create. See Firestore locations.
Confirm and create the database. Leave it empty; do not create employee/payroll collections manually yet.
Open the Firestore Rules tab and confirm that the initial rules deny client access. Production mode is expected to begin locked. Leave those rules unchanged for now.

Firestore is a document database: collections group documents, and documents hold fields. We will finalize the MotorPH paths and access rules in code before adding data. The candidate paths in the earlier plan are provisional, not a final schema.

Why locked mode: Firestore checks web/mobile client requests against Security Rules. The official starting rule can deny all reads and writes until rules are designed. Some privileged server SDKs instead use IAM and bypass Firestore Rules, so we will not put a service-account key in the browser or a downloadable client. See Firestore Security Rules.

4. Enable Firebase Authentication (Email/Password)
In the Firebase Console, open Build → Authentication (sometimes shown as Security → Authentication).
Click Get started if prompted.
Open Sign-in method / Sign-in providers.
Choose Email/Password, enable the basic Email/Password provider, and save. Email-link/passwordless sign-in is not needed for this first setup.
Do not add a public sign-up link or invite real users yet. We will add a controlled development sign-in path after wiring the app.
You do not need to create an app user yet. Authentication identifies a user; it does not by itself authorize access to Firestore. Firestore Rules will decide what the signed-in user may do.

Firebase’s official password-auth setup describes enabling this provider in the console.

5. What to send back

Please send only these public Web App config fields (you may paste the exact values into a code block):

text
apiKey:       
authDomain:   
projectId:    
appId:        

The projectId is essential. Please also tell me the Firestore location you selected (for example, asia-southeast1) and confirm that the database is in Production/locked mode and Email/Password Auth is enabled.

Do not send any of these:

Firebase service-account JSON or private key;
Google Cloud service-account credentials;
a user's password;
Firebase ID token or refresh token;
a password reset link or authentication cookie.

If the Console displays a service-account/private-key download, close it; we do not need it for this browser-authenticated design.

6. What happens after you provide the config

I will:

add the public config to the local development configuration without exposing any private credential;
wire Firebase Authentication into the browser flow;
define restrictive Firestore Rules before trying reads/writes;
use only synthetic employee/attendance records for the first round trip;
test an allowed operation and a denied operation; and
keep payroll calculations disabled unless an exact rule and expected result are present in the supplied materials.

We will not create a production dataset, deploy public write rules, or store privileged credentials in the browser.

Troubleshooting / pause points
Console asks you to upgrade or add billing: pause and report the message. Do not add a payment method yet.
Project ID already in use: choose another suggested ID and send the exact final value.
Location already set or Singapore not offered: stop before provisioning and tell me what locations/options the console shows. The database location is a durable choice.
Rules tab shows open access (if true) or test mode: do not add data; switch back to locked rules or tell me what you see.
You already created the project: do not recreate it. Open Project settings → General → Your apps and copy the Web App config; verify Firestore and Auth settings above.
Open

I’ve written and opened the step-by-step guide: Firebase development setup for MotorPH MS2.

The important choices are: register a Web App, create Firestore in Production/locked mode, enable Email/Password Authentication, and—if offered—choose the Singapore (asia-southeast1) database region. Choose carefully: Firestore’s database location cannot be changed after creation. Firestore locations

The guide explains how to retrieve the public Web App config and what to send me. Firebase’s web API key is public project/app identification, not a password; access is controlled by Authentication and Firestore Security Rules. Firebase API key guidance Keep Firestore locked for now: Production mode denies client reads/writes until rules are added, and privileged server SDKs can bypass those rules. Firestore setup Security Rules

When you’ve created the project, send only apiKey, authDomain, projectId, and appId, plus the Firestore region and confirmation that Auth is enabled. Do not send passwords, tokens, or a service-account private key.

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Minimal Java 11 web server for the first browser-based prototype. */
public final class AppServer {
    private static final Path WEB_ROOT = Paths.get("web").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final AttendanceService attendanceService;

    public AppServer() {
        EmployeeStore employeeStore = new InMemoryEmployeeStore();
        employeeService = new EmployeeService(employeeStore);
        attendanceService = new AttendanceService(employeeService, new InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore(), new InMemoryAttendanceStore());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        int port = Integer.parseInt(System.getenv().getOrDefault("PORT", "8080"));
        new AppServer().start(port);
    }

    private void start(int port) throws IOException {
        HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("0.0.0.0", port), 0);
        server.createContext("/api/health", this::handleHealth);
        server.createContext("/api/employees", this::handleEmployees);
        server.createContext("/api/attendance", this::handleAttendance);
        server.createContext("/", this::handleStaticFiles);
        server.setExecutor(Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8));
        server.start();
        System.out.println("MotorPH prototype listening on 0.0.0.0:" + port);
        System.out.println("Serving browser files from " + WEB_ROOT);
    }

    private void handleHealth(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"status\":\"ok\",\"mode\":\"synthetic-demo\"}");
    }

    private void handleEmployees(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        if ("/api/employees".equals(path) || "/api/employees/".equals(path)) {
            String query = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "q");
            List<Employee> matches = employeeService.searchEmployees(query);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, employeesToJson(matches, employeeService.listEmployees().size()));
            return;
        }
        String id = path.substring("/api/employees/".length());
        if (id.isEmpty() || id.contains("/")) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
            return;
        }
        Optional<Employee> employee = employeeService.findEmployee(id);
        if (!employee.isPresent()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
            return;
        }
        sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(employee.get()) + "}");
    }

    private void handleAttendance(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String employeeId = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "employeeId");
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"employeeId is required\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            LocalDate from = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "from"));
            LocalDate to = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "to"));
            List<AttendanceRecord> records = attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, attendanceToJson(records));
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (java.util.NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
        }
    }

    private static LocalDate parseOptionalDate(String value) {
        return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() ? null : LocalDate.parse(value.trim());
    }

    private static String attendanceToJson(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            AttendanceRecord record = records.get(i);
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append("{\"attendanceId\":").append(record.getAttendanceId())
                .append(",\"scheduleId\":").append(record.getScheduleId())
                .append(",\"date\":\"").append(record.getDate())
                .append("\",\"timeIn\":\"").append(record.getTimeIn())
                .append("\",\"timeOut\":\"").append(record.getTimeOut())
                .append("\",\"dayType\":\"").append(escapeJson(record.getDayType())).append("\"}");
        }
        return json.append("],\"count\":").append(records.size())
            .append(",\"hoursCalculated\":false}").toString();
    }

    private void handleStaticFiles(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        boolean headOnly = "HEAD".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod());
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod()) && !headOnly) {
            sendText(exchange, 405, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Method not allowed");
            return;
        }
        String requestPath = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        if (requestPath == null || "/".equals(requestPath)) requestPath = "/index.html";
        Path requested = WEB_ROOT.resolve(requestPath.substring(1)).normalize();
        if (!requested.startsWith(WEB_ROOT) || !Files.isRegularFile(requested)) {
            sendText(exchange, 404, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Not found");
            return;
        }
        String contentType = contentTypeFor(requested);
        byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(requested);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", contentType);
        if (headOnly) {
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Length", Integer.toString(bytes.length));
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, -1);
            exchange.close();
            return;
        }
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
    }

    private static String employeesToJson(List<Employee> employees, int total) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < employees.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append(employeeToJson(employees.get(i)));
        }
        return json.append("],\"total\":")
            .append(total)
            .append(",\"matched\":")
            .append(employees.size())
            .append('}')
            .toString();
    }

    private static String employeeToJson(Employee employee) {
        return "{"
            + "\"id\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getId()) + "\"," 
            + "\"name\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getName()) + "\"," 
            + "\"department\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getDepartment()) + "\"," 
            + "\"role\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getRole()) + "\"," 
            + "\"location\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getLocation()) + "\"," 
            + "\"status\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getStatus()) + "\"}"
            ;
    }

    private static String queryParameter(String rawQuery, String target) {
        if (rawQuery == null || rawQuery.isEmpty()) return "";
        for (String part : rawQuery.split("&")) {
            int separator = part.indexOf('=');
            String key = separator < 0 ? part : part.substring(0, separator);
            if (target.equals(decode(key))) return separator < 0 ? "" : decode(part.substring(separator + 1));
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String decode(String value) {
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(value, "UTF-8");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException ex) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static String contentTypeFor(Path path) {
        String name = path.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase();
        if (name.endsWith(".html")) return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".css")) return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".js")) return "application/javascript; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".svg")) return "image/svg+xml";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }

    private static String escapeJson(String value) {
        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")
            .replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\t", "\\t");
    }

    private static void sendJson(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {
        sendText(exchange, status, "application/json; charset=utf-8", body);
    }

    private static void sendText(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String type, String body) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", type);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

/** Employee use cases, separated from HTTP handling and the storage implementation. */
public final class EmployeeService {
    private final EmployeeStore store;

    public EmployeeService(EmployeeStore store) {
        if (store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("store must not be null");
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<Employee> listEmployees() {
        return store.findAll();
    }

    public Optional<Employee> findEmployee(String id) {
        return store.findById(id == null ? null : id.trim());
    }

    /** Empty query returns all; search is case-insensitive across the displayed fields. */
    public List<Employee> searchEmployees(String query) {
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) return store.findAll();
        String normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return store.findAll().stream()
            .filter(employee -> searchableText(employee).contains(normalized))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private String searchableText(Employee employee) {
        return (employee.getId() + " " + employee.getName() + " " + employee.getDepartment() + " "
            + employee.getRole() + " " + employee.getLocation() + " " + employee.getStatus())
            .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}

    public Employee(String id, String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        this.id = requireText(id, "id");
        this.name = requireText(name, "name");
        this.department = requireText(department, "department");

        this.location = requireText(location, "location");

    private static String requireText(String value, String field) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, field + " must not be null");

        return value.trim();
    }

    public String getName() { return name; }
    public String getDepartment() { return department; }
    public String getRole() { return role; }
    public String getLocation() { return location; }
    public String getStatus() { return status; }
}

/** Raw attendance data model aligned to the supplied MO-IT107 Attendance fields. */
public final class AttendanceRecord {
    private final int attendanceId;
    private final int scheduleId;
    private final LocalDate date;
    private final LocalTime timeIn;
    private final LocalTime timeOut;
    private final String dayType;

    public AttendanceRecord(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, LocalDate date,
                            LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        if (attendanceId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendanceId must be positive");
        if (scheduleId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scheduleId must be positive");
        this.date = Objects.requireNonNull(date, "date must not be null");
        this.timeIn = Objects.requireNonNull(timeIn, "timeIn must not be null");
        this.timeOut = Objects.requireNonNull(timeOut, "timeOut must not be null");
        if (timeIn.isAfter(timeOut)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeIn must be less than or equal to timeOut per the supplied data dictionary");
        }
        if (dayType == null || dayType.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dayType must not be blank");
        this.attendanceId = attendanceId;
        this.scheduleId = scheduleId;
        this.dayType = dayType.trim();
    }

    public int getAttendanceId() { return attendanceId; }
    public int getScheduleId() { return scheduleId; }
    public LocalDate getDate() { return date; }
    public LocalTime getTimeIn() { return timeIn; }
    public LocalTime getTimeOut() { return timeOut; }
    public String getDayType() { return dayType; }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.OptionalInt;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Reads raw attendance for one employee; deliberately does not calculate paid hours. */
public final class AttendanceService {
    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore;
    private final AttendanceStore attendanceStore;

    public AttendanceService(EmployeeService employeeService, EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore,
                             AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
        if (employeeService == null || scheduleStore == null || attendanceStore == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service dependencies must not be null");
        }
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.scheduleStore = scheduleStore;
        this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
    }

    /** Inclusive optional date filtering; no pay-period calendar is inferred. */
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("from date must be on or before to date");
        }
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) return java.util.Collections.emptyList();
        return attendanceStore.findByScheduleId(scheduleId.getAsInt()).stream()
            .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
            .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}

/** Temporary raw attendance fixture. All entries and classifications are synthetic. */
public final class InMemoryAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final List<AttendanceRecord> records;

    public InMemoryAttendanceStore() {
        List<AttendanceRecord> values = new ArrayList<>();
        values.add(record(5001, 101, "2026-10-01", "08:01", "17:00"));
        values.add(record(5002, 101, "2026-10-02", "07:58", "16:59"));
        values.add(record(5003, 101, "2026-10-15", "08:03", "17:01"));
        values.add(record(5101, 102, "2026-10-01", "08:00", "17:02"));
        values.add(record(5102, 102, "2026-10-03", "08:04", "17:03"));
        values.add(record(5201, 103, "2026-10-02", "08:10", "16:55"));
        records = Collections.unmodifiableList(values);
        enforceUniqueScheduleDate(records);
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return records.stream()
            .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord record(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, String date, String in, String out) {
        return new AttendanceRecord(attendanceId, scheduleId, LocalDate.parse(date),
            LocalTime.parse(in), LocalTime.parse(out), "DEMO");
    }

    private static void enforceUniqueScheduleDate(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            String key = record.getScheduleId() + ":" + record.getDate();
            if (!keys.add(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate attendance for schedule/date: " + key);
        }
    }
}

function initials(name) {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map(part => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
}

function makeCell(content) {
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  if (content instanceof Node) cell.append(content);
  else cell.textContent = content;
  return cell;
}

function showTableMessage(message) {
  rows.replaceChildren();
  const row = document.createElement('tr');
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  cell.colSpan = 6;
  cell.className = 'table-message';
  cell.textContent = message;
  row.append(cell);
  rows.append(row);
}

function renderEmployees() {
  rows.replaceChildren();
  if (state.employees.length === 0) {
    showTableMessage(search.value.trim() ? 'No employee records match that search.' : 'No demo records are available.');
  } else {
    state.employees.forEach(employee => {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      row.className = 'employee-row';
      row.tabIndex = 0;
      row.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      row.setAttribute('aria-label', `Open ${employee.name}, ${employee.id}`);
      row.addEventListener('click', () => openEmployee(employee));
      row.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          openEmployee(employee);
        }
      });

      const person = document.createElement('div');
      person.className = 'person-cell';
      const avatar = document.createElement('span');
      avatar.className = 'person-initials';
      avatar.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      avatar.textContent = initials(employee.name);
      const nameBlock = document.createElement('span');
      const name = document.createElement('span');
      name.className = 'person-name';
      name.textContent = employee.name;
      const id = document.createElement('span');
      id.className = 'person-id';
      id.textContent = employee.id;
      nameBlock.append(name, id);
      person.append(avatar, nameBlock);
      row.append(makeCell(person));
      row.append(makeCell(employee.department));
      row.append(makeCell(employee.role));
      row.append(makeCell(employee.location));

      const status = document.createElement('span');
      status.className = `status-pill${employee.status.toLowerCase() === 'active' ? '' : ' leave'}`;
      status.textContent = employee.status;
      row.append(makeCell(status));

      arrow.className = 'row-arrow';
      arrow.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      arrow.textContent = '›';
      row.append(makeCell(arrow));
      rows.append(row);
    });
  }

  count.textContent = String(state.totalEmployees).padStart(2, '0');
  const overviewCount = document.getElementById('overview-employee-count');
  if (overviewCount) overviewCount.textContent = String(state.totalEmployees).padStart(2, '0');

}

async function loadAttendance() {
  const employeeId = attendanceEmployee.value;
  if (!employeeId) {
    showAttendanceMessage('Load the employee directory first.');
    return;
  }
  const requestNumber = ++state.attendanceRequestNumber;
  showAttendanceMessage('Loading raw attendance records…');
  attendanceResultCount.textContent = 'Loading';
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ employeeId });
  const from = document.getElementById('attendance-from').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('attendance-to').value;
  if (from) params.set('from', from);
  if (to) params.set('to', to);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/attendance?${params.toString()}`, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    if (requestNumber !== state.attendanceRequestNumber) return;
    renderAttendance(Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : []);
  } catch (error) {
    if (requestNumber !== state.attendanceRequestNumber) return;
    showAttendanceMessage(error.message || 'Could not load attendance records.');
    attendanceResultCount.textContent = 'Could not load records';
  }
}

async function loadEmployees() {
  const requestNumber = ++state.requestNumber;
  const query = search.value.trim();
  showTableMessage('Loading employee records…');
  resultCount.textContent = 'Loading';
  try {
    const url = query ? `/api/employees?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : '/api/employees';
    const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Request failed (${response.status})`);
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.items)) throw new Error('Unexpected employee response');
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = payload.items;
    state.totalEmployees = Number.isInteger(payload.total) ? payload.total : payload.items.length;
    if (!query) {
      state.allEmployees = payload.items;
      populateAttendanceEmployees();
    }
    renderEmployees();
  } catch (error) {
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = [];
    renderEmployees();
    showTableMessage('Could not reach the Java service. Check that the prototype server is running, then refresh.');
    resultCount.textContent = 'Service unavailable';
  }
}

function switchView(view) {
  const labels = { overview: 'Overview', employees: 'Employees', attendance: 'Attendance', payroll: 'Payroll' };
  if (!labels[view]) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.page-view').forEach(page => {
    page.hidden = page.id !== `${view}-view`;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(nav => {
    const active = nav.dataset.view === view;
    nav.classList.toggle('active', active);
    if (active) nav.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    else nav.removeAttribute('aria-current');
  });
  document.getElementById('crumb-current').textContent = labels[view];
  document.title = `${labels[view]} — MotorPH Payroll Office`;
  if (view === 'attendance' && attendanceEmployee.value) loadAttendance();
}

document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
  item.addEventListener('click', () => switchView(item.dataset.view));
});

/** Synthetic employee-to-schedule mapping; replace with the approved source later. */
public final class InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore implements EmployeeScheduleStore {
    private final Map<String, Integer> scheduleByEmployee;

    public InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore() {
        Map<String, Integer> values = new HashMap<>();
        values.put("DEMO-001", 101);
        values.put("DEMO-002", 102);
        values.put("DEMO-003", 103);
        scheduleByEmployee = Collections.unmodifiableMap(values);
    }

    @Override
    public OptionalInt findScheduleIdForEmployee(String employeeId) {
        Integer scheduleId = employeeId == null ? null : scheduleByEmployee.get(employeeId);
        return scheduleId == null ? OptionalInt.empty() : OptionalInt.of(scheduleId);
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Employee use cases, separated from HTTP handling and the storage implementation. */
public final class EmployeeService {
    private final EmployeeStore store;

    public EmployeeService(EmployeeStore store) {
        if (store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("store must not be null");
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<Employee> listEmployees() {
        return store.findAll();
    }

    public Optional<Employee> findEmployee(String id) {
        return store.findById(id == null ? null : id.trim());
    }

    /** Empty query returns all; search is case-insensitive across the displayed fields. */
    public List<Employee> searchEmployees(String query) {
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) return store.findAll();
        String normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return store.findAll().stream()
            .filter(employee -> searchableText(employee).contains(normalized))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private String searchableText(Employee employee) {
        return (employee.getId() + " " + employee.getName() + " " + employee.getDepartment() + " "
            + employee.getRole() + " " + employee.getLocation() + " " + employee.getStatus())
            .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Java 11 HTTP backend for the browser-based MotorPH prototype. */
public final class AppServer {
    private final Path webRoot = Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("WEB_ROOT", "web")).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
    private final String firebaseProjectId = System.getenv().getOrDefault("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID", "").trim();
    private final EmployeeService localEmployeeService = new EmployeeService(new InMemoryEmployeeStore());
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore localScheduleStore = new InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore();
    private final AttendanceStore localAttendanceStore = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        int port = Integer.parseInt(System.getenv().getOrDefault("PORT", "8080"));
        String host = System.getenv().getOrDefault("HOST", "0.0.0.0");
        new AppServer().start(host, port);
    }

    private void start(String host, int port) throws IOException {
        HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(host, port), 0);
        server.createContext("/api/health", this::handleHealth);
        server.createContext("/api/employees", this::handleEmployees);
        server.createContext("/api/attendance", this::handleAttendance);
        server.createContext("/api/demo/seed", this::handleSeedDemo);
        server.createContext("/", this::handleStaticFiles);
        server.setExecutor(Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8));
        server.start();
        System.out.println("MotorPH Java API listening on " + host + ":" + port);
        System.out.println("Mode: " + (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local synthetic demo" : "Firebase-authenticated user sandbox"));
        System.out.println("Serving browser files from " + webRoot);
    }

    private void handleHealth(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String mode = firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-synthetic-demo" : "firebase-user-sandbox";
        sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"status\":\"ok\",\"mode\":\"" + mode + "\"}");
    }

    private void handleEmployees(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
            String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
            if ("/api/employees".equals(path) || "/api/employees/".equals(path)) {
                String query = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "q");
                List<Employee> matches = services.employeeService.searchEmployees(query);
                int total = services.employeeService.listEmployees().size();
                sendJson(exchange, 200, employeesToJson(matches, total));
                return;
            }
            String id = path.substring("/api/employees/".length());
            if (id.isEmpty() || id.contains("/")) {
                sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                return;
            }
            Optional<Employee> employee = services.employeeService.findEmployee(id);
            if (!employee.isPresent()) {
                sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                return;
            }
            sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(employee.get()) + "}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private void handleAttendance(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String employeeId = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "employeeId");
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"employeeId is required\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
            LocalDate from = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "from"));
            LocalDate to = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "to"));
            AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService,
                localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
            List<AttendanceRecord> records = attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, attendanceToJson(records));
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (java.util.NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private void handleSeedDemo(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Firebase is not configured for this server.\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            FirestoreRestClient client = firestoreClientFor(exchange);
            DemoSeedService.SeedResult result = new DemoSeedService(client).seedMissingSyntheticRecords();
            sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"employeesCreated\":" + result.getEmployeesCreated()
                + ",\"attendanceCreated\":" + result.getAttendanceCreated()
                + ",\"syntheticOnly\":true}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private RequestServices servicesFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            return new RequestServices(localEmployeeService, localAttendanceStore);
        }
        FirestoreRestClient client = firestoreClientFor(exchange);
        return new RequestServices(new EmployeeService(new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client)), new FirestoreAttendanceStore(client));
    }

    private FirestoreRestClient firestoreClientFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        String authorization = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization");
        String uid = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Firebase-UID");
        if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ") || uid == null || uid.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Sign in with your Firebase account to continue.", 401);
        }
        String token = authorization.substring("Bearer ".length()).trim();
        if (token.length() > 8192 || uid.length() > 128 || uid.contains("/")) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Invalid Firebase session information.", 401);
        }
        return new FirestoreRestClient(firebaseProjectId, uid, token);
    }

    private static LocalDate parseOptionalDate(String value) {
        return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() ? null : LocalDate.parse(value.trim());
    }

    private static String attendanceToJson(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            AttendanceRecord record = records.get(i);
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append("{\"attendanceId\":").append(record.getAttendanceId())
                .append(",\"scheduleId\":").append(record.getScheduleId())
                .append(",\"date\":\"").append(record.getDate())
                .append("\",\"timeIn\":\"").append(record.getTimeIn())
                .append("\",\"timeOut\":\"").append(record.getTimeOut())
                .append("\",\"dayType\":\"").append(escapeJson(record.getDayType())).append("\"}");
        }
        return json.append("],\"count\":").append(records.size())
            .append(",\"hoursCalculated\":false}").toString();
    }

    private void handleStaticFiles(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        boolean headOnly = "HEAD".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod());
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod()) && !headOnly) {
            sendText(exchange, 405, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Method not allowed");
            return;
        }
        String requestPath = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        if (requestPath == null || "/".equals(requestPath)) requestPath = "/index.html";
        Path requested = webRoot.resolve(requestPath.substring(1)).normalize();
        if (!requested.startsWith(webRoot) || !Files.isRegularFile(requested)) {
            sendText(exchange, 404, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Not found");
            return;
        }
        String contentType = contentTypeFor(requested);
        byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(requested);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Security-Policy",
            "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; "
                + "connect-src 'self' https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com; "
                + "object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", contentType);
        if (headOnly) {
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Length", Integer.toString(bytes.length));
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, -1);
            exchange.close();
            return;
        }
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
    }

    private static String employeesToJson(List<Employee> employees, int total) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < employees.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append(employeeToJson(employees.get(i)));
        }
        return json.append("],\"total\":").append(total)
            .append(",\"matched\":").append(employees.size()).append('}').toString();
    }

    private static String employeeToJson(Employee employee) {
        return "{"
            + "\"id\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getId()) + "\"," 
            + "\"name\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getName()) + "\"," 
            + "\"department\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getDepartment()) + "\"," 
            + "\"role\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getRole()) + "\"," 
            + "\"location\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getLocation()) + "\"," 
            + "\"status\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getStatus()) + "\"}"
            ;
    }

    private static String queryParameter(String rawQuery, String target) {
        if (rawQuery == null || rawQuery.isEmpty()) return "";
        for (String part : rawQuery.split("&")) {
            int separator = part.indexOf('=');
            String key = separator < 0 ? part : part.substring(0, separator);
            if (target.equals(decode(key))) return separator < 0 ? "" : decode(part.substring(separator + 1));
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String decode(String value) {
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(value, "UTF-8");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException ex) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static String contentTypeFor(Path path) {
        String name = path.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase();
        if (name.endsWith(".html")) return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".css")) return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".js")) return "application/javascript; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".svg")) return "image/svg+xml";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }

    private static String escapeJson(String value) {
        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")
            .replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\t", "\\t");
    }

    private static void sendApiError(HttpExchange exchange, FirestoreException exception) throws IOException {
        int status = exception.getStatusCode();
        if (status < 400 || status > 599) status = 500;
        sendJson(exchange, status, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(exception.getMessage()) + "\"}");
    }

    private static void sendJson(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {
        sendText(exchange, status, "application/json; charset=utf-8", body);
    }

    private static void sendText(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String type, String body) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", type);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
    }

    private static final class RequestServices {
        private final EmployeeService employeeService;
        private final AttendanceStore attendanceStore;

        RequestServices(EmployeeService employeeService, AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
            this.employeeService = employeeService;
            this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
        }
    }
}

service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function signedInAs(uid) {
      return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }

    function validDemoEmployee(employeeId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == employeeId && d.id.size() <= 40
        && d.name is string && d.name.size() > 0 && d.name.size() <= 100
        && d.department is string && d.department.size() <= 100
        && d.role is string && d.role.size() <= 100
        && d.location is string && d.location.size() <= 100
        && d.status is string && d.status.size() <= 40;
    }

    function validDemoAttendance() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.attendanceId is int && d.attendanceId > 0
        && d.scheduleId is int && d.scheduleId > 0
        && d.date is string && d.date.size() == 10
        && d.timeIn is string && d.timeIn.size() == 5
        && d.timeOut is string && d.timeOut.size() == 5
        && d.dayType == 'DEMO';
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoEmployees/{employeeId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoEmployee(employeeId);
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoAttendance/{attendanceId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoAttendance();
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    // Default-deny: no other Firestore document paths are available to clients.
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }

DemoSeedService.java

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.Arrays;

/** Creates only fictional, clearly marked records in one signed-in user's demo sandbox. */
public final class DemoSeedService {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public DemoSeedService(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    public SeedResult seedMissingSyntheticRecords() {
        int employeesCreated = 0;
        for (Employee employee : new InMemoryEmployeeStore().findAll()) {
            if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), employee.getId(), employeeFields(employee))) {
                employeesCreated++;
            }
        }

        int attendanceCreated = 0;
        InMemoryAttendanceStore sampleAttendance = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();
        for (int scheduleId : Arrays.asList(101, 102, 103)) {
            for (AttendanceRecord record : sampleAttendance.findByScheduleId(scheduleId)) {
                if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"),
                    Integer.toString(record.getAttendanceId()), attendanceFields(record))) {
                    attendanceCreated++;
                }
            }
        }
        return new SeedResult(employeesCreated, attendanceCreated);
    }

    private static JsonObject employeeFields(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", string(employee.getId()));
        fields.add("name", string(employee.getName()));
        fields.add("department", string(employee.getDepartment()));
        fields.add("role", string(employee.getRole()));
        fields.add("location", string(employee.getLocation()));
        fields.add("status", string(employee.getStatus()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject attendanceFields(AttendanceRecord record) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("attendanceId", integer(record.getAttendanceId()));
        fields.add("scheduleId", integer(record.getScheduleId()));
        fields.add("date", string(record.getDate().toString()));
        fields.add("timeIn", string(record.getTimeIn().toString()));
        fields.add("timeOut", string(record.getTimeOut().toString()));
        fields.add("dayType", string("DEMO"));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject string(String value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return typedValue;
    }

    private static JsonObject integer(int value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("integerValue", Integer.toString(value));
        return typedValue;
    }

    public static final class SeedResult {
        private final int employeesCreated;
        private final int attendanceCreated;

        SeedResult(int employeesCreated, int attendanceCreated) {
            this.employeesCreated = employeesCreated;
            this.attendanceCreated = attendanceCreated;
        }

        public int getEmployeesCreated() { return employeesCreated; }
        public int getAttendanceCreated() { return attendanceCreated; }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** User-scoped synthetic attendance records read through Firestore REST. */
public final class FirestoreAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreAttendanceStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"))) {
            records.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return records.stream().filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new AttendanceRecord(
            integerValue(fields, "attendanceId"), integerValue(fields, "scheduleId"),
            LocalDate.parse(stringValue(fields, "date")), LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeIn")),
            LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeOut")), stringValue(fields, "dayType"));
    }

    private static int integerValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("integerValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(value.getAsString());
    }

    private static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return FirestoreEmployeeStore.stringValue(fields, name);
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/** User-scoped demo employee records read through the Firestore REST API. */
public final class FirestoreEmployeeStore implements EmployeeStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreEmployeeStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<Employee> findAll() {
        List<Employee> employees = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"))) {
            employees.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return employees;
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        if (id == null) return Optional.empty();
        return findAll().stream().filter(employee -> employee.getId().equals(id)).findFirst();
    }

    private static Employee fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new Employee(
            stringValue(fields, "id"), stringValue(fields, "name"), stringValue(fields, "department"),
            stringValue(fields, "role"), stringValue(fields, "location"), stringValue(fields, "status"));
    }

    static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("stringValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? "" : value.getAsString();
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

/** A safe, user-facing Firestore REST failure with an HTTP status for API mapping. */
public final class FirestoreException extends RuntimeException {
    private final int statusCode;

    public FirestoreException(String message, int statusCode) {
        super(message);
        this.statusCode = statusCode;
    }

    public int getStatusCode() { return statusCode; }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Small Firestore REST client that forwards a Firebase Auth ID token. Firestore
 * Security Rules, not server credentials, authorize every read and write.
 */
public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            if (ex instanceof FirestoreException) throw (FirestoreException) ex;
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(API_ROOT)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "Firebase sign-in expired. Sign out and sign in again.";
        else if (status == 403) message = "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.";
        else if (status == 404) message = "Firestore database or requested resource was not found. Check the Firebase project and database setup.";
        else if (status == 409 || status == 400) message = "A demo record could not be created. Refresh the page and try again.";
        return new FirestoreException(message, status);
    }
}

import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { createUserWithEmailAndPassword, getAuth, inMemoryPersistence, onAuthStateChanged, setPersistence, signInWithEmailAndPassword, signOut } from 'firebase/auth';

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY || '',
  authDomain: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN || '',
  projectId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || '',
  storageBucket: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET || '',
  messagingSenderId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID || '',
  appId: import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID || ''
};
const firebaseConfigured = Boolean(firebaseConfig.apiKey && firebaseConfig.projectId && firebaseConfig.appId
  && !firebaseConfig.apiKey.toLowerCase().includes('replace') && !firebaseConfig.apiKey.toLowerCase().includes('paste_'));
const firebaseApp = firebaseConfigured ? initializeApp(firebaseConfig) : null;
const auth = firebaseApp ? getAuth(firebaseApp) : null;
const state = { employees: [], allEmployees: [], totalEmployees: 0, selected: null, searchTimer: null, requestNumber: 0, attendanceRequestNumber: 0, user: null };

const authGate = document.getElementById('auth-gate');
const appShell = document.getElementById('app-shell');
const authError = document.getElementById('auth-error');
const authEmail = document.getElementById('auth-email');
const authPassword = document.getElementById('auth-password');
const signInButton = document.getElementById('sign-in-button');
const createAccountButton = document.getElementById('create-account-button');

function setAuthError(message) {
  authError.textContent = message;
  authError.hidden = !message;
}

function friendlyAuthError(error) {
  const code = error && error.code || '';
  if (code === 'auth/operation-not-allowed') return 'Email/Password sign-in is disabled. Enable it in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.';
  if (code === 'auth/unauthorized-domain') return 'This preview domain is not authorized. Add its host under Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, or test on localhost.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-api-key' || code === 'auth/api-key-not-valid.-please-pass-a-valid-api-key.') return 'The Firebase Web API key in .env.local is missing or invalid.';
  if (code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') return 'That email already has a Firebase account. Use Sign in instead.';
  if (code === 'auth/weak-password') return 'Use a password with at least six characters.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || code === 'auth/wrong-password' || code === 'auth/user-not-found') return 'Email or password is incorrect.';
  return error && error.message ? error.message : 'Firebase sign-in could not be completed.';
}

async function signIn() {
  setAuthError('');
  try {
    await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, authEmail.value.trim(), authPassword.value);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
  }
}

async function createDevAccount() {
  setAuthError('');
  try {
    await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, authEmail.value.trim(), authPassword.value);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
  }
}

async function apiHeaders(extra = {}) {
  const headers = { Accept: 'application/json', ...extra };
  if (state.user) {
    const token = await state.user.getIdToken();
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    headers['X-Firebase-UID'] = state.user.uid;
  }
  return headers;
}

function showWorkspace(user) {
  state.user = user;
  authGate.hidden = true;
  appShell.hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('sign-out-button').hidden = !user;
  document.getElementById('operator-label').textContent = user ? 'USER SANDBOX' : 'LOCAL PREVIEW';
  document.getElementById('operator-avatar').textContent = user ? (user.email || 'D').slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() : 'D';
  loadEmployees();
}

function showSignIn(message = '') {
  state.user = null;
  appShell.hidden = true;
  authGate.hidden = false;
  setAuthError(message);
}

if (!firebaseConfigured) {
  showWorkspace(null);
} else {
  document.getElementById('auth-form').addEventListener('submit', event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    signIn();
  });
  createAccountButton.addEventListener('click', createDevAccount);
  document.getElementById('sign-out-button').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try { await signOut(auth); } catch (error) { console.error('Firebase sign-out failed', error); }
  });
  setPersistence(auth, inMemoryPersistence)
    .then(() => onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
      if (user) showWorkspace(user);
      else showSignIn();
    }))
    .catch(error => showSignIn(friendlyAuthError(error)));
}
