import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

const moduleOrError = await import('../../web/csv-export.js').catch(error => ({ importError: error }));
function api() {
  assert.ok(!moduleOrError.importError, 'CSV export module should load');
  assert.equal(typeof moduleOrError.buildCsv, 'function', 'buildCsv should be exported');
  return moduleOrError.buildCsv;
}

test('builds RFC-style quoted CSV rows with CRLF separators', () => {
  const buildCsv = api();
  const csv = buildCsv([
    { key: 'id', label: 'Employee ID' },
    { key: 'name', label: 'Name' }
  ], [{ id: 'DEMO-001', name: 'Mara Rivera' }]);
  assert.equal(csv, '"Employee ID","Name"\r\n"DEMO-001","Mara Rivera"');
});

test('quotes commas, double-quotes, and line breaks safely', () => {
  const buildCsv = api();
  const csv = buildCsv([{ key: 'note', label: 'Note' }], [{ note: 'Clock, corrected "demo"\nnext line' }]);
  assert.equal(csv, '"Note"\r\n"Clock, corrected ""demo""\nnext line"');
});

test('neutralizes spreadsheet formula prefixes after leading whitespace', () => {
  const buildCsv = api();
  const rows = ['=1+1', '+SUM(A1:A2)', '-2+3', '@NOW()', '  =HYPERLINK("x")']
    .map(value => ({ value }));
  const csv = buildCsv([{ key: 'value', label: 'Value' }], rows);
  assert.equal(csv.split('\r\n').slice(1).join('\r\n'), [
    '"\'=1+1"', '"\'+SUM(A1:A2)"', '"\'-2+3"', '"\'@NOW()"', '"\'  =HYPERLINK(""x"")"'
  ].join('\r\n'));
});

test('renders missing and null values as empty cells', () => {
  const buildCsv = api();
  assert.equal(buildCsv([{ key: 'a', label: 'A' }, { key: 'b', label: 'B' }], [{ a: null }, {}]),
    '"A","B"\r\n"",""\r\n"",""');
});

test('rejects malformed column and row inputs', () => {
  const buildCsv = api();
  assert.throws(() => buildCsv([], []), /at least one column/i);
  assert.throws(() => buildCsv([{ key: '', label: 'Name' }], []), /key and label/i);
  assert.throws(() => buildCsv([{ key: 'id', label: 'ID' }], {}), /rows must be an array/i);
});

csv-export.js

function validateColumns(columns) {
  if (!Array.isArray(columns) || columns.length === 0) throw new TypeError('CSV must include at least one column.');
  columns.forEach((column, index) => {
    if (!column || typeof column.key !== 'string' || !column.key.trim()
      || typeof column.label !== 'string' || !column.label.trim()) {
      throw new TypeError(`CSV column ${index + 1} must include a key and label.`);
    }
  });
}

function csvCell(value) {
  const text = String(value ?? '');
  // Prefix spreadsheet formula-like cells with an apostrophe before quoting.
  // This includes formula markers preceded by whitespace, tabs, or line breaks.
  const safeText = /^[\s]*[=+\-@]/u.test(text) ? `'${text}` : text;
  return `"${safeText.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
}

export function buildCsv(columns, rows) {
  validateColumns(columns);
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new TypeError('CSV rows must be an array.');
  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) {
      throw new TypeError(`CSV row ${index + 1} must be an object.`);
    }
  });
  const header = columns.map(column => csvCell(column.label)).join(',');
  const body = rows.map(row => columns.map(column => csvCell(row[column.key])).join(','));
  return [header, ...body].join('\r\n');
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Small Firestore REST client that forwards a Firebase Auth ID token. Firestore
 * Security Rules, not server credentials, authorize every read and write.
 */
public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String apiRoot;
    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    /** Package-private endpoint override for isolated HTTP contract tests. */
    FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "Firebase sign-in expired. Sign out and sign in again.";
        else if (status == 403) message = "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.";
        else if (status == 404) message = "Firestore database or requested resource was not found. Check the Firebase project and database setup.";
        else if (status == 409 || status == 400) message = "A demo record could not be created. Refresh the page and try again.";
        return new FirestoreException(message, status);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/** User-scoped demo employee records read through the Firestore REST API. */
public final class FirestoreEmployeeStore implements EmployeeStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreEmployeeStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<Employee> findAll() {
        List<Employee> employees = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"))) {
            employees.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return employees;
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        if (id == null) return Optional.empty();
        return findAll().stream().filter(employee -> employee.getId().equals(id)).findFirst();
    }

    private static Employee fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new Employee(
            stringValue(fields, "id"), stringValue(fields, "name"), stringValue(fields, "department"),
            stringValue(fields, "role"), stringValue(fields, "location"), stringValue(fields, "status"));
    }

    static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("stringValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? "" : value.getAsString();
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** User-scoped synthetic attendance records read through Firestore REST. */
public final class FirestoreAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreAttendanceStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"))) {
            records.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return records.stream().filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new AttendanceRecord(
            integerValue(fields, "attendanceId"), integerValue(fields, "scheduleId"),
            LocalDate.parse(stringValue(fields, "date")), LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeIn")),
            LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeOut")), stringValue(fields, "dayType"));
    }

    private static int integerValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("integerValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(value.getAsString());
    }

    private static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return FirestoreEmployeeStore.stringValue(fields, name);
    }
}

service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function signedInAs(uid) {
      return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }

    function validDemoEmployee(employeeId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == employeeId && d.id.size() <= 40
        && d.name is string && d.name.size() > 0 && d.name.size() <= 100
        && d.department is string && d.department.size() > 0 && d.department.size() <= 100
        && d.role is string && d.role.size() > 0 && d.role.size() <= 100
        && d.location is string && d.location.size() > 0 && d.location.size() <= 100
        && d.status in ['Active', 'On leave'];
    }

    function validDemoAttendance() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.attendanceId is int && d.attendanceId > 0
        && d.scheduleId is int && d.scheduleId > 0
        && d.date is string && d.date.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.timeIn is string && d.timeIn.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.timeOut is string && d.timeOut.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.dayType == 'DEMO';
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoEmployees/{employeeId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoEmployee(employeeId);
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoAttendance/{attendanceId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoAttendance();
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    // Default-deny: no other Firestore document paths are available to clients.
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}

    private static String employeesToJson(List<Employee> employees, int total) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < employees.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append(employeeToJson(employees.get(i)));
        }
        return json.append("],\"total\":").append(total)
            .append(",\"matched\":").append(employees.size()).append('}').toString();
    }

    private static String employeeToJson(Employee employee) {
        return "{"
            + "\"id\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getId()) + "\"," 
            + "\"name\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getName()) + "\"," 
            + "\"department\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getDepartment()) + "\"," 
            + "\"role\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getRole()) + "\"," 
            + "\"location\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getLocation()) + "\"," 
            + "\"status\":\"" + escapeJson(employee.getStatus()) + "\"}"
            ;
    }

    private static String queryParameter(String rawQuery, String target) {
        if (rawQuery == null || rawQuery.isEmpty()) return "";
        for (String part : rawQuery.split("&")) {
            int separator = part.indexOf('=');
            String key = separator < 0 ? part : part.substring(0, separator);
            if (target.equals(decode(key))) return separator < 0 ? "" : decode(part.substring(separator + 1));
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String decode(String value) {
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(value, "UTF-8");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException ex) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static String contentTypeFor(Path path) {
        String name = path.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase();
        if (name.endsWith(".html")) return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".css")) return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".js")) return "application/javascript; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".svg")) return "image/svg+xml";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }

    private static String escapeJson(String value) {
        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")
            .replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\t", "\\t");
    }

    private static void sendApiError(HttpExchange exchange, FirestoreException exception) throws IOException {
        int status = exception.getStatusCode();
        if (status < 400 || status > 599) status = 500;
        sendJson(exchange, status, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(exception.getMessage()) + "\"}");
    }

    private static void sendJson(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {
        sendText(exchange, status, "application/json; charset=utf-8", body);
    }

    private static void sendText(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String type, String body) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", type);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
    }

    private static final class RequestServices {
        private final EmployeeService employeeService;
        private final AttendanceStore attendanceStore;

        RequestServices(EmployeeService employeeService, AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
            this.employeeService = employeeService;
            this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
        }
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

/** Offline HTTP integration checks for local mode and the Firebase auth gate. */
public final class AppServerIntegrationTest {
    private static int checks;
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newHttpClient();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        localModeServesSyntheticEmployeeAndAttendanceResponses();
        staticFilesExposeDefensiveHeadersAndRejectTraversal();
        firebaseModeRejectsUnauthenticatedReadsAndWritesBeforeFirestore();
        firebaseModeRejectsPartialAndMalformedSessionsBeforeFirestore();
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " AppServer integration checks");
    }

    private static void localModeServesSyntheticEmployeeAndAttendanceResponses() throws Exception {
        AppServer app = new AppServer("", Paths.get("web"));
        HttpServer server = app.start("127.0.0.1", 0);
        try {
            URI base = URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort());
            HttpResponse<String> health = get(base.resolve("/api/health"));
            check(health.statusCode() == 200 && health.body().contains("local-synthetic-demo"), "local health mode reported");

            HttpResponse<String> employees = get(base.resolve("/api/employees?q=finance"));
            check(employees.statusCode() == 200 && employees.body().contains("Eli Santos"), "local employee search works over HTTP");

            HttpResponse<String> noMatches = get(base.resolve("/api/employees?q=not-a-person"));
            check(noMatches.statusCode() == 200 && noMatches.body().contains("\"items\":[]"), "empty employee search is a valid empty result");

            HttpResponse<String> employee = get(base.resolve("/api/employees/DEMO-001"));
            check(employee.statusCode() == 200 && employee.body().contains("\"name\":\"Mara Rivera\""), "employee detail returns selected record over HTTP");
            HttpResponse<String> missingEmployee = get(base.resolve("/api/employees/UNKNOWN"));
            check(missingEmployee.statusCode() == 404, "unknown employee detail returns not found");

            HttpResponse<String> attendance = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001&from=2026-10-01&to=2026-10-15"));
            check(attendance.statusCode() == 200 && attendance.body().contains("\"hoursCalculated\":false"), "local attendance stays raw");

            HttpResponse<String> oneDay = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001&from=2026-10-02&to=2026-10-02"));
            check(oneDay.statusCode() == 200 && oneDay.body().contains("\"count\":1")
                && oneDay.body().contains("\"date\":\"2026-10-02\""), "attendance date bounds include the selected day");

            HttpResponse<String> noAttendance = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-002&from=2026-10-10&to=2026-10-10"));
            check(noAttendance.statusCode() == 200 && noAttendance.body().contains("\"count\":0"), "empty selected period returns an empty attendance result");

            HttpResponse<String> missingAttendanceEmployee = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance"));
            check(missingAttendanceEmployee.statusCode() == 400, "attendance query requires an employee ID");

            HttpResponse<String> badDate = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001&from=not-a-date"));
            check(badDate.statusCode() == 400, "malformed attendance date returns client error");

            HttpResponse<String> invalidRange = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001&from=2026-10-15&to=2026-10-01"));
            check(invalidRange.statusCode() == 400, "reversed date range returns client error");
        } finally {
            app.stop();
        }
    }

    private static void staticFilesExposeDefensiveHeadersAndRejectTraversal() throws Exception {
        AppServer app = new AppServer("", Paths.get("web"));
        HttpServer server = app.start("127.0.0.1", 0);
        try {
            URI base = URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort());
            HttpResponse<String> root = get(base.resolve("/"));
            check(root.statusCode() == 200, "static app root is served");
            check(root.headers().firstValue("Content-Security-Policy").orElse("").contains("default-src 'self'"),
                "static app root has a restrictive content security policy");
            check("nosniff".equalsIgnoreCase(root.headers().firstValue("X-Content-Type-Options").orElse("")),
                "static app root disables MIME sniffing");

            HttpResponse<String> envFile = get(base.resolve("/.env.local"));
            check(envFile.statusCode() == 404, "environment file is not served from the web root");
            HttpResponse<String> traversal = get(base.resolve("/%2e%2e/.env.local"));
            check(traversal.statusCode() == 404, "static path traversal cannot read outside the web root");
        } finally {
            app.stop();
        }
    }

    private static void firebaseModeRejectsUnauthenticatedReadsAndWritesBeforeFirestore() throws Exception {
        AppServer app = new AppServer("motorph-jd", Paths.get("web"));
        HttpServer server = app.start("127.0.0.1", 0);
        try {
            URI base = URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort());
            HttpResponse<String> health = get(base.resolve("/api/health"));
            check(health.statusCode() == 200 && health.body().contains("firebase-user-sandbox"), "Firebase mode reported");

            HttpResponse<String> employees = get(base.resolve("/api/employees"));
            check(employees.statusCode() == 401 && employees.body().contains("Sign in"), "employee read requires Firebase sign-in");

            HttpResponse<String> attendance = get(base.resolve("/api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001"));
            check(attendance.statusCode() == 401, "attendance read requires Firebase sign-in");

            HttpRequest seed = HttpRequest.newBuilder(base.resolve("/api/demo/seed"))
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody()).build();
            HttpResponse<String> seedResponse = HTTP.send(seed, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            check(seedResponse.statusCode() == 401, "demo write requires Firebase sign-in");
        } finally {
            app.stop();
        }
    }

    private static void firebaseModeRejectsPartialAndMalformedSessionsBeforeFirestore() throws Exception {
        AppServer app = new AppServer("motorph-jd", Paths.get("web"));
        HttpServer server = app.start("127.0.0.1", 0);
        try {
            URI employeesUri = URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/api/employees");
            HttpRequest tokenOnly = HttpRequest.newBuilder(employeesUri).GET()
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer local-test-token").build();
            HttpResponse<String> missingUid = HTTP.send(tokenOnly, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            check(missingUid.statusCode() == 401, "Firebase ID token without UID header is rejected locally");

            HttpRequest uidOnly = HttpRequest.newBuilder(employeesUri).GET()
                .header("X-Firebase-UID", "synthetic-test-user").build();
            HttpResponse<String> missingToken = HTTP.send(uidOnly, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            check(missingToken.statusCode() == 401, "UID header without Firebase ID token is rejected locally");

            HttpRequest invalidUid = HttpRequest.newBuilder(employeesUri).GET()
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer local-test-token")
                .header("X-Firebase-UID", "invalid/user").build();
            HttpResponse<String> invalidSession = HTTP.send(invalidUid, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            check(invalidSession.statusCode() == 401, "malformed UID is rejected locally");
        } finally {
            app.stop();
        }
    }

    private static HttpResponse<String> get(URI uri) throws Exception {
        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).GET().header("Accept", "application/json").build();
        return HTTP.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** Offline tests for Firestore REST token forwarding, document mapping, and errors. */
public final class FirestoreRestClientTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        listsUserDocumentsWithTheBearerTokenAndMapsEmployeeFields();
        mapsPermissionDenialWithoutExposingRequestCredentials();
        createsDocumentsWithTypedFieldsAndHandlesAlreadyExistingSeedRecords();
        rejectsPathInjectionInUserIdentifiers();
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " Firestore REST adapter checks");
    }

    private static void listsUserDocumentsWithTheBearerTokenAndMapsEmployeeFields() throws Exception {
        String response = "{\"documents\":[{\"name\":\"projects/motorph-jd/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-123/demoEmployees/DEMO-001\","
            + "\"fields\":{\"id\":{\"stringValue\":\"DEMO-001\"},\"name\":{\"stringValue\":\"Mara Rivera\"},"
            + "\"department\":{\"stringValue\":\"People Operations\"},\"role\":{\"stringValue\":\"HR Coordinator\"},"
            + "\"location\":{\"stringValue\":\"Makati\"},\"status\":{\"stringValue\":\"Active\"}}}]}";
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(200, response)) {
            FirestoreRestClient client = client(server);
            List<Employee> employees = new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client).findAll();
            check(employees.size() == 1, "one employee returned");
            check("Mara Rivera".equals(employees.get(0).getName()), "employee name mapped");
            check("Active".equals(employees.get(0).getStatus()), "employee status mapped");
            check("Bearer test-id-token".equals(server.authorization.get()), "Firebase ID token forwarded as bearer");
            check("GET".equals(server.method.get()), "collection read uses GET");
            check(server.path.get().contains("/users/user-123/demoEmployees"), "read is scoped to the supplied user path");
        }
    }

    private static void mapsPermissionDenialWithoutExposingRequestCredentials() throws Exception {
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(403,
            "{\"error\":{\"code\":403,\"status\":\"PERMISSION_DENIED\"}}")) {
            try {
                client(server).listDocuments("users/user-123/demoEmployees");
                throw new AssertionError("expected FirestoreException for permission denial");
            } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
                check(ex.getStatusCode() == 403, "permission denial keeps HTTP 403");
                check(ex.getMessage().contains("Firestore denied"), "permission denial has actionable text");
                check(!ex.getMessage().contains("test-id-token"), "error does not include ID token");
            }
        }
    }

    private static void createsDocumentsWithTypedFieldsAndHandlesAlreadyExistingSeedRecords() throws Exception {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject id = new JsonObject();
        id.addProperty("stringValue", "DEMO-001");
        fields.add("id", id);
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(200,
            "{\"name\":\"projects/motorph-jd/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-123/demoEmployees/DEMO-001\"}")) {
            FirestoreRestClient client = client(server);
            check(client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), "DEMO-001", fields), "new document reports created");
            check("POST".equals(server.method.get()), "document creation uses POST");
            check(server.path.get().contains("documentId=DEMO-001"), "document ID is explicit");
            check(server.requestBody.get().contains("stringValue"), "Firestore typed field body is sent");
        }
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(409,
            "{\"error\":{\"code\":409,\"status\":\"ALREADY_EXISTS\"}}")) {
            check(!client(server).createDocument("users/user-123/demoEmployees", "DEMO-001", fields),
                "re-seeding does not overwrite an existing document");
        }
    }

    private static void rejectsPathInjectionInUserIdentifiers() {
        try {
            new FirestoreRestClient("motorph-jd", "user/other", "token");
            throw new AssertionError("expected invalid UID to be rejected");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
            check(true, "UID cannot escape its Firestore path segment");
        }
    }

    private static FirestoreRestClient client(FakeFirestoreServer server) {
        return new FirestoreRestClient("motorph-jd", "user-123", "test-id-token", server.apiRoot());
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    private static final class FakeFirestoreServer implements AutoCloseable {
        private final HttpServer server;
        private final int status;
        private final String responseBody;
        private final AtomicReference<String> authorization = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> method = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> path = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> requestBody = new AtomicReference<>("");

        FakeFirestoreServer(int status, String responseBody) throws IOException {
            this.status = status;
            this.responseBody = responseBody;
            server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            server.createContext("/", this::handle);
            server.start();
        }

        String apiRoot() {
            return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/v1/projects/";
        }

        private void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            authorization.set(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization"));
            method.set(exchange.getRequestMethod());
            path.set(exchange.getRequestURI().toString());
            requestBody.set(new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            byte[] bytes = responseBody.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(bytes);
            exchange.close();
        }

        @Override
        public void close() {
            server.stop(0);
        }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Employee use cases, separated from HTTP handling and the storage implementation. */
public final class EmployeeService {
    private final EmployeeStore store;

    public EmployeeService(EmployeeStore store) {
        if (store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("store must not be null");
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<Employee> listEmployees() {
        return store.findAll();
    }

    public Optional<Employee> findEmployee(String id) {
        return store.findById(id == null ? null : id.trim());
    }

    /** Empty query returns all; search is case-insensitive across the displayed fields. */
    public List<Employee> searchEmployees(String query) {
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) return store.findAll();
        String normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return store.findAll().stream()
            .filter(employee -> searchableText(employee).contains(normalized))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private String searchableText(Employee employee) {
        return (employee.getId() + " " + employee.getName() + " " + employee.getDepartment() + " "
            + employee.getRole() + " " + employee.getLocation() + " " + employee.getStatus())
            .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}

/** A safe, user-facing Firestore REST failure with an HTTP status for API mapping. */
public final class FirestoreException extends RuntimeException {
    private final int statusCode;

    public FirestoreException(String message, int statusCode) {
        super(message);
        this.statusCode = statusCode;
    }

    public int getStatusCode() { return statusCode; }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Firestore user-subcollection adapter. Firestore Rules enforce owner-only access. */
public final class FirestoreWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private static final String LEAVE_COLLECTION = "demoLeaveRequests";
    private static final String TICKET_COLLECTION = "demoTickets";
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreWorkflowStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        List<DemoLeaveRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION))) {
            requests.add(leaveFromDocument(document));
        }
        requests.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoLeaveRequest::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return requests;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), request.getId(), leaveFields(request))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest current = listLeaveRequests().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Pending review".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        List<DemoTicket> tickets = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION))) {
            tickets.add(ticketFromDocument(document));
        }
        tickets.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoTicket::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return tickets;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), ticket.getId(), ticketFields(ticket))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket current = listTickets().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Open".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    private static JsonObject leaveFields(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(request.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(request.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employeeName", stringField(request.getEmployeeName()));
        fields.add("leaveType", stringField(request.getLeaveType()));
        fields.add("startDate", stringField(request.getStartDate()));
        fields.add("endDate", stringField(request.getEndDate()));
        fields.add("note", stringField(request.getNote()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(request.getStatus()));
        fields.add("submittedAt", timestampField(request.getSubmittedAt()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject ticketFields(DemoTicket ticket) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(ticket.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(ticket.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employeeName", stringField(ticket.getEmployeeName()));
        fields.add("ticketType", stringField(ticket.getTicketType()));
        fields.add("queue", stringField(ticket.getQueue()));
        fields.add("summary", stringField(ticket.getSummary()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(ticket.getStatus()));
        fields.add("submittedAt", timestampField(ticket.getSubmittedAt()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static DemoLeaveRequest leaveFromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = fields(document);
        return new DemoLeaveRequest(documentId(document), value(fields, "employeeId"), value(fields, "employeeName"),
            value(fields, "leaveType"), value(fields, "startDate"), value(fields, "endDate"), value(fields, "note"),
            value(fields, "status"), dateTimeValue(fields, "submittedAt"), dateTimeValue(fields, "cancelledAt"));
    }

    private static DemoTicket ticketFromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = fields(document);
        return new DemoTicket(documentId(document), value(fields, "employeeId"), value(fields, "employeeName"),
            value(fields, "ticketType"), value(fields, "queue"), value(fields, "summary"), value(fields, "status"),
            dateTimeValue(fields, "submittedAt"), dateTimeValue(fields, "cancelledAt"));
    }

    private static JsonObject fields(JsonObject document) {
        return document.has("fields") && document.get("fields").isJsonObject()
            ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
    }

    private static String documentId(JsonObject document) {
        String name = document.has("name") ? document.get("name").getAsString() : "";
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash < 0 || slash == name.length() - 1) throw new IllegalStateException("Firestore workflow document has no ID.");
        return name.substring(slash + 1);
    }

    private static String value(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonObject typed = element.getAsJsonObject();
        if (typed.has("stringValue")) return typed.get("stringValue").getAsString();
        if (typed.has("timestampValue")) return typed.get("timestampValue").getAsString();
        return "";
    }

    private static String dateTimeValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return fields.has(name) ? value(fields, name) : "";
    }

    private static JsonObject stringField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return field;
    }

    private static JsonObject timestampField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("timestampValue", value);
        return field;
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.UUID;

/** Validates and coordinates safe, non-payroll workflow demonstrations. */
public final class WorkflowService {
    private static final int MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 240;
    private static final List<String> LEAVE_TYPES = Collections.unmodifiableList(
        Arrays.asList("Vacation", "Medical", "Personal", "Unpaid"));
    private static final Map<String, String> TICKET_QUEUES;
    static {
        Map<String, String> queues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        queues.put("Overtime request", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Leave request", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Timesheet correction", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Payroll inquiry", "Payroll Staff");
        queues.put("HR inquiry", "HR");
        queues.put("Technical support", "IT Admin");
        TICKET_QUEUES = Collections.unmodifiableMap(queues);
    }

    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final WorkflowStore store;

    public WorkflowService(EmployeeService employeeService, WorkflowStore store) {
        if (employeeService == null || store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("workflow dependencies must not be null");
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() { return store.listLeaveRequests(); }
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() { return store.listTickets(); }

    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(String employeeId, String leaveType,
            String startDate, String endDate, String note) {
        Employee employee = requireEmployee(employeeId);
        if (!LEAVE_TYPES.contains(leaveType)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a valid leave type.");
        LocalDate start = parseDate(startDate, "start date");
        LocalDate end = parseDate(endDate, "end date");
        if (start.isAfter(end)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The start date must be on or before the end date.");
        String safeNote = optionalText(note, "Note");
        String id = "LV-" + randomSuffix();
        return store.createLeaveRequest(new DemoLeaveRequest(id, employee.getId(), employee.getName(), leaveType,
            start.toString(), end.toString(), safeNote, "Pending review", Instant.now().toString(), ""));
    }

    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id) {
        requireId(id, "LV-");
        return store.cancelLeaveRequest(id, Instant.now().toString());
    }

    public DemoTicket createTicket(String employeeId, String ticketType, String summary) {
        Employee employee = requireEmployee(employeeId);
        String queue = TICKET_QUEUES.get(ticketType);
        if (queue == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a valid ticket type.");
        String safeSummary = requiredText(summary, "Message");
        String id = "TK-" + randomSuffix();
        return store.createTicket(new DemoTicket(id, employee.getId(), employee.getName(), ticketType, queue,
            safeSummary, "Open", Instant.now().toString(), ""));
    }

    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id) {
        requireId(id, "TK-");
        return store.cancelTicket(id, Instant.now().toString());
    }

    private Employee requireEmployee(String employeeId) {
        String id = requiredText(employeeId, "Employee ID");
        return employeeService.findEmployee(id).orElseThrow(() ->
            new NoSuchElementException("Choose an employee from your synthetic demo directory."));
    }

    private static LocalDate parseDate(String value, String field) {
        String text = requiredText(value, field);
        try {
            LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(text);
            if (!date.toString().equals(text)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD " + field + ".");
            return date;
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD " + field + ".");
        }
    }

    private static String requiredText(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " is required.");
        if (text.length() > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be " + MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + " characters or fewer.");
        return text;
    }

    private static String optionalText(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.length() > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be " + MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + " characters or fewer.");
        return text;
    }

    private static String randomSuffix() {
        return UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 12).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static void requireId(String id, String prefix) {
        if (id == null || !id.matches(prefix + "[A-F0-9]{12}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Workflow record ID is invalid.");
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Process-memory store used only by the unauthenticated local synthetic preview. */
public final class InMemoryWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private final Map<String, DemoLeaveRequest> leaveRequests = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, DemoTicket> tickets = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public synchronized List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        return new ArrayList<>(leaveRequests.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (leaveRequests.containsKey(request.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists.");
        leaveRequests.put(request.getId(), request);
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest existing = leaveRequests.get(id);
        if (existing == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found.");
        if (!"Pending review".equals(existing.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        DemoLeaveRequest cancelled = existing.cancelled(cancelledAt);
        leaveRequests.put(id, cancelled);
        return cancelled;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        return new ArrayList<>(tickets.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (tickets.containsKey(ticket.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists.");
        tickets.put(ticket.getId(), ticket);
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket existing = tickets.get(id);
        if (existing == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found.");
        if (!"Open".equals(existing.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        DemoTicket cancelled = existing.cancelled(cancelledAt);
        tickets.put(id, cancelled);
        return cancelled;
    }
}

firestore.rules
PLAIN
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function signedInAs(uid) {
      return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }

    function validDemoEmployee(employeeId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == employeeId && d.id.size() <= 40
        && d.name is string && d.name.size() > 0 && d.name.size() <= 100
        && d.department is string && d.department.size() > 0 && d.department.size() <= 100
        && d.role is string && d.role.size() > 0 && d.role.size() <= 100
        && d.location is string && d.location.size() > 0 && d.location.size() <= 100
        && d.status in ['Active', 'On leave'];
    }

    function validDemoAttendance() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.attendanceId is int && d.attendanceId > 0
        && d.scheduleId is int && d.scheduleId > 0
        && d.date is string && d.date.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.timeIn is string && d.timeIn.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.timeOut is string && d.timeOut.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.dayType == 'DEMO';
    }

    function ownsDemoEmployee(uid, employeeId, employeeName) {
      let employeePath = /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(uid)/demoEmployees/$(employeeId);
      return employeeId is string && employeeId.matches('^DEMO-[0-9]{3}$')
        && employeeName is string
        && exists(employeePath)
        && get(employeePath).data.name == employeeName;
    }

    function validDemoLeaveRequest(uid, requestId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'note', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'note', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == requestId && d.id.matches('^LV-[A-F0-9]{12}$')
        && ownsDemoEmployee(uid, d.employeeId, d.employeeName)
        && d.leaveType in ['Vacation', 'Medical', 'Personal', 'Unpaid']
        && d.startDate is string && d.startDate.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.endDate is string && d.endDate.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.startDate <= d.endDate
        && d.note is string && d.note.size() <= 240
        && d.status == 'Pending review'
        && d.submittedAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validDemoLeaveCancellation(uid, requestId) {
      let previous = resource.data;
      let next = request.resource.data;
      return signedInAs(uid)
        && previous.id == requestId
        && previous.status == 'Pending review'
        && next.id == previous.id
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasAll(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.status == 'Cancelled'
        && next.cancelledAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validTicketQueue(ticketType, queue) {
      return (ticketType in ['Overtime request', 'Leave request', 'Timesheet correction'] && queue == 'Team Lead')
        || (ticketType == 'Payroll inquiry' && queue == 'Payroll Staff')
        || (ticketType == 'HR inquiry' && queue == 'HR')
        || (ticketType == 'Technical support' && queue == 'IT Admin');
    }

    function validDemoTicket(uid, ticketId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == ticketId && d.id.matches('^TK-[A-F0-9]{12}$')
        && ownsDemoEmployee(uid, d.employeeId, d.employeeName)
        && validTicketQueue(d.ticketType, d.queue)
        && d.summary is string && d.summary.size() > 0 && d.summary.size() <= 240
        && d.status == 'Open'
        && d.submittedAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validDemoTicketCancellation(uid, ticketId) {
      let previous = resource.data;
      let next = request.resource.data;
      return signedInAs(uid)
        && previous.id == ticketId
        && previous.status == 'Open'
        && next.id == previous.id
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasAll(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.status == 'Cancelled'
        && next.cancelledAt is timestamp;
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoEmployees/{employeeId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoEmployee(employeeId);
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoAttendance/{attendanceId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoAttendance();
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    // Owner-only demo requests. There are deliberately no reviewer, approval, or delete permissions.
    match /users/{uid}/demoLeaveRequests/{requestId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoLeaveRequest(uid, requestId);
      allow update: if validDemoLeaveCancellation(uid, requestId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoTickets/{ticketId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoTicket(uid, ticketId);
      allow update: if validDemoTicketCancellation(uid, ticketId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    // Default-deny: no other Firestore document paths are available to clients.
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}

async function seedSyntheticDemoData() {
  seedDemoButton.disabled = true;
  seedDemoButton.textContent = 'Writing synthetic records…';
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/demo/seed', { method: 'POST', headers: await apiHeaders() });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    resultCount.textContent = `${payload.employeesCreated} employees and ${payload.attendanceCreated} attendance entries added`;
    await loadEmployees();
  } catch (error) {
    showTableMessage(error.message || 'Could not write the synthetic demo records.');
    resultCount.textContent = 'Demo setup failed';
  } finally {
    seedDemoButton.disabled = false;
    seedDemoButton.textContent = 'Add synthetic demo data';
  }
}

function handleWorkflowCancel(event) {
  const button = event.target.closest('button[data-action]');
  if (!button) return;
  try {
    if (button.dataset.action === 'cancel-leave') {
      state.workflow = cancelLeaveRequest(state.workflow, button.dataset.id, button.dataset.employeeId);
      setWorkflowStatus('leave-form-status', `${button.dataset.id} marked cancelled in browser memory.`);
    } else if (button.dataset.action === 'cancel-ticket') {
      state.workflow = cancelTicket(state.workflow, button.dataset.id, button.dataset.employeeId);
      setWorkflowStatus('ticket-form-status', `${button.dataset.id} marked cancelled in browser memory.`);
    }
    renderWorkflow();
  } catch (error) {
    const formStatus = button.dataset.action === 'cancel-leave' ? 'leave-form-status' : 'ticket-form-status';
    setWorkflowStatus(formStatus, error.message || 'Could not cancel this demo item.', true);
  }
}

FirestoreWorkflowStoreTest.java

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** Offline checks for workflow document paths, typed fields, mapping, and status-only updates. */
public final class FirestoreWorkflowStoreTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        createsRequestsInTheCurrentUserSubcollection();
        listsTicketsAndMapsFirestoreFields();
        cancelsOnlyByPatchingStatusAndTimestamp();
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " Firestore workflow-store checks");
    }

    private static void createsRequestsInTheCurrentUserSubcollection() throws Exception {
        String id = "LV-012345ABCDEF";
        try (FakeFirestore server = new FakeFirestore(new Reply(200,
            "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests/" + id + "\"}"))) {
            FirestoreWorkflowStore store = new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client(server));
            DemoLeaveRequest request = new DemoLeaveRequest(id, "DEMO-001", "Mara Rivera", "Vacation",
                "2026-11-10", "2026-11-11", "Synthetic only", "Pending review", "2026-11-03T10:00:00Z", "");
            check(store.createLeaveRequest(request) == request, "created workflow returned to caller");
            check(server.methods.get(0).equals("POST"), "workflow creation uses Firestore POST");
            check(server.paths.get(0).contains("/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests")
                && server.paths.get(0).contains("documentId=" + id), "leave request path is scoped to user UID");
            check(server.bodies.get(0).contains("Pending review") && server.bodies.get(0).contains("timestampValue"),
                "leave fields use Firestore string and timestamp types");
            check("Bearer test-id-token".equals(server.authorization.get()), "ID token is forwarded for Firestore authorization");
        }
    }

    private static void listsTicketsAndMapsFirestoreFields() throws Exception {
        String document = "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoTickets/TK-012345ABCDEF\","
            + "\"fields\":{\"employeeId\":{\"stringValue\":\"DEMO-002\"},\"employeeName\":{\"stringValue\":\"Eli Santos\"},"
            + "\"ticketType\":{\"stringValue\":\"Timesheet correction\"},\"queue\":{\"stringValue\":\"Team Lead\"},"
            + "\"summary\":{\"stringValue\":\"Fictional correction\"},\"status\":{\"stringValue\":\"Open\"},"
            + "\"submittedAt\":{\"timestampValue\":\"2026-11-03T10:00:00Z\"}}}";
        try (FakeFirestore server = new FakeFirestore(new Reply(200, "{\"documents\":[" + document + "]}"))) {
            List<DemoTicket> tickets = new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client(server)).listTickets();
            check(tickets.size() == 1, "one ticket mapped from user collection");
            check("TK-012345ABCDEF".equals(tickets.get(0).getId()), "ticket ID mapped from document path");
            check("Team Lead".equals(tickets.get(0).getQueue()), "ticket queue label mapped");
            check("Open".equals(tickets.get(0).getStatus()), "ticket status mapped");
            check(server.paths.get(0).contains("/users/user-7/demoTickets"), "ticket list uses user-scoped collection");
        }
    }

    private static void cancelsOnlyByPatchingStatusAndTimestamp() throws Exception {
        String id = "LV-012345ABCDEF";
        String document = "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests/" + id + "\","
            + "\"fields\":{\"employeeId\":{\"stringValue\":\"DEMO-001\"},\"employeeName\":{\"stringValue\":\"Mara Rivera\"},"
            + "\"leaveType\":{\"stringValue\":\"Vacation\"},\"startDate\":{\"stringValue\":\"2026-11-10\"},"
            + "\"endDate\":{\"stringValue\":\"2026-11-11\"},\"note\":{\"stringValue\":\"\"},"
            + "\"status\":{\"stringValue\":\"Pending review\"},\"submittedAt\":{\"timestampValue\":\"2026-11-03T10:00:00Z\"}}}";
        try (FakeFirestore server = new FakeFirestore(
            new Reply(200, "{\"documents\":[" + document + "]}"),
            new Reply(200, "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests/" + id + "\"}"))) {
            DemoLeaveRequest cancelled = new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client(server)).cancelLeaveRequest(id, "2026-11-03T11:00:00Z");
            check("Cancelled".equals(cancelled.getStatus()), "cancelled response reflects new state");
            check(server.methods.equals(Arrays.asList("GET", "PATCH")), "cancellation reads current state then patches");
            check(server.paths.get(1).contains("updateMask.fieldPaths=status")
                && server.paths.get(1).contains("updateMask.fieldPaths=cancelledAt"), "patch mask contains only cancellation fields");
            check(server.bodies.get(1).contains("Cancelled") && !server.bodies.get(1).contains("employeeName"),
                "cancellation cannot rewrite employee or request fields");
        }
    }

    private static FirestoreRestClient client(FakeFirestore server) {
        return new FirestoreRestClient("demo", "user-7", "test-id-token", server.apiRoot());
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    private static final class Reply {
        private final int status;
        private final String body;
        Reply(int status, String body) { this.status = status; this.body = body; }
    }

    private static final class FakeFirestore implements AutoCloseable {
        private final HttpServer server;
        private final List<Reply> replies;
        private final List<String> methods = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<String> paths = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<String> bodies = new ArrayList<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> authorization = new AtomicReference<>();
        private int nextReply;

        FakeFirestore(Reply... replies) throws IOException {
            this.replies = Arrays.asList(replies);
            server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            server.createContext("/", this::handle);
            server.start();
        }

        String apiRoot() { return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/v1/projects/"; }

        private synchronized void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            methods.add(exchange.getRequestMethod());
            paths.add(exchange.getRequestURI().toString());
            authorization.set(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization"));
            bodies.add(new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            Reply reply = replies.get(Math.min(nextReply++, replies.size() - 1));
            byte[] bytes = reply.body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(reply.status, bytes.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(bytes);
            exchange.close();
        }

        @Override public void close() { server.stop(0); }
    }
}

# Firestore rules review — development sandbox

**Review status:** The user reports publishing `docs/firestore.rules` in Firebase Console. Live Email/Password Auth and authenticated Java API tests now pass against Firestore under the active rules; all test accounts/documents were cleaned up. Seeding created 3 synthetic employees + 6 attendance entries; repeating it created 0 duplicates. Cross-user access, payroll paths, and an extra salary field were denied. The Java REST adapter's automated tests still use a local fake HTTP server; separate live API calls provide the deployed-rules verification. The Firebase Console Rules Playground/Emulator was not separately used.

Reviewed file: `docs/firestore.rules`

## Verdict

The candidate rules are appropriately narrow for a disposable synthetic-data sandbox, with explicit limitations. They are **not a production MotorPH employee/payroll authorization policy** and should not be used for real employee, attendance, or payroll data.

## What the rules permit

- An authenticated account can read only documents in its own `users/{uid}/demoEmployees` and `users/{uid}/demoAttendance` collections.
- That account can create/update only documents with exact allowlisted fields. Employee documents have no salary, government identifier, or payroll fields; attendance documents must be structurally date/time-like and carry `dayType: "DEMO"`.
- An account can delete only its own demo documents.
- All other Firestore paths—including root employee collections and all payroll paths—fall through to deny.
- The Java backend forwards the Firebase ID token. It uses the browser-supplied UID only to form a document path; Firestore Rules compare that path UID with `request.auth.uid`, so the header alone grants no access.

The overlapping catch-all `allow read, write: if false` is intentional: specific matching allows grant only the two scoped paths; the false rule does not cancel them. Firestore evaluates every request against the active ruleset. See [Firestore Security Rules](https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/security/get-started).

## Risks and limitations

1. **Self-service accounts:** the app offers development-account creation. Every account is limited to its own isolated sandbox, but there is no company membership, HR role, supervisor role, or admin workflow.
2. **No organization-wide employee access:** per-user data is deliberately not shared between users. This is safe for testing, but not the eventual multi-user payroll design.
3. **No payroll data:** the strict field allowlists intentionally reject payroll/rate/pay fields. No payroll collection has an allow rule.
4. **Domain constraints not fully expressible here:** the rules check date/time string formats, while Java parses dates/times. They do not enforce `timeIn <= timeOut` or uniqueness of `(scheduleId, date)` across separate documents. The current seed fixture is unique and the Java model validates time order; a future attendance-write feature needs an explicit, transaction-safe uniqueness design.
5. **Own-data edits/deletes:** a signed-in user can modify or delete their own demo records. There is no audit log or recovery mechanism.
6. **Project administrators:** project owners and privileged Google Cloud IAM identities may access data through administrative channels; client Security Rules are not a replacement for IAM controls.
7. **No App Check / production hardening:** not necessary for this isolated classroom prototype, but production deployment would require a broader security review, abuse controls, hosting review, monitoring, and an authorization design.

The rules use `String.matches()` for date/time shape checks, supported by the [Rules String reference](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/rules/rules.String). The patterns are format checks, not full calendar validation; Java performs strict parsing on read.

## Post-publication live validation

The following were tested using disposable Firebase Auth accounts and synthetic records through the running Java API / Firestore REST. Results reflect live calls after the user published the rules; the Console Rules Playground and Emulator were not separately used.

| Case | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Authenticated user seeds own demo collections | `200`; 3 employees + 6 attendance documents created |
| Repeat seed for same user | `200`; 0 employees + 0 attendance documents added (idempotent) |
| List/search/detail and selected employee attendance read | `200`; expected synthetic records returned |
| Inclusive one-day attendance range | `200`; exactly one raw record; `hoursCalculated:false` |
| Empty date range | `200`; zero records |
| Unknown employee | `404` |
| Reversed date range | `400` |
| Unauthenticated app request | `401` |
| Spoofed UID / cross-user sandbox path | `403` |
| Payroll collection path | `403` |
| Extra salary field on synthetic employee | `403` |
| Test cleanup | PASS; temporary Auth account and all test documents removed |

This verifies the required Task 1–3 synthetic paths and the tested deny cases against the active rules. It does not make these rules a production HR/payroll policy. Official rules semantics and testing guidance: [Get started with Firestore Security Rules](https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/security/get-started).

# Prototype API contract

All routes are same-origin JSON endpoints. In local mode, records come from in-memory synthetic fixtures. When `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` is configured, employee and attendance routes require a signed-in Firebase user and use only that user's Firestore sandbox. The Java backend forwards the user's Firebase ID token to Firestore REST; Firestore Security Rules authorize every request.

In Firebase mode, browser requests include:

```text
Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>
X-Firebase-UID: <signed-in Firebase UID>
```

The UID header is not trusted for authorization: Firestore Rules compare it to the UID in the verified ID token. Do not log or persist ID tokens.

## Health

`GET /api/health`

Local mode:

```json
{"status":"ok","mode":"local-synthetic-demo"}
```

Firebase mode reports `firebase-user-sandbox`.

## Employee directory

`GET /api/employees`

`GET /api/employees?q=finance`

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "DEMO-002",
      "name": "Eli Santos",
      "department": "Finance",
      "role": "Payroll Associate",
      "location": "Taguig",
      "status": "Active"
    }
  ],
  "total": 3,
  "matched": 1
}
```

Search is case-insensitive across displayed fields. `total` is the full user-scoped demo directory size; `matched` is the returned count.

`GET /api/employees/{employeeId}` returns `{"item": {...}}` or `404 {"error":"Employee not found"}`.

## Raw attendance

`GET /api/attendance?employeeId=DEMO-001`

Optional ISO date filters: `from=YYYY-MM-DD` and/or `to=YYYY-MM-DD`. If both are supplied, `from` must be on or before `to`; filtering is inclusive. `employeeId` is required.

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "attendanceId": 5001,
      "scheduleId": 101,
      "date": "2026-10-01",
      "timeIn": "08:01",
      "timeOut": "17:00",
      "dayType": "DEMO"
    }
  ],
  "count": 1,
  "hoursCalculated": false
}
```

Possible errors: `400` for missing employee ID, invalid date syntax, or reversed range; `404` for an unknown employee; `401` for missing/expired Firebase sign-in; `403` when Firestore Rules deny the request. Raw times only; no hours or pay are derived.

## Opt-in demo seed

`POST /api/demo/seed`

Requires Firebase Authentication and Firestore mode. Creates missing fictional documents only in:

- `users/{uid}/demoEmployees/{employeeId}`
- `users/{uid}/demoAttendance/{attendanceId}`

The endpoint does not overwrite existing records and marks attendance with `dayType: "DEMO"`. It cannot create payroll documents. Firestore Rules are in `docs/firestore.rules`.

## Scope and security

- No production employee or payroll records.
- No service account, Admin SDK, or privileged credentials.
- Current user-owned sandbox rules are development-only, not an organizational role model.
- Payroll formulas, pay-period logic, and calculations remain blocked until specified by supplied course materials.

## What works

- Overview, searchable employee directory/detail, raw attendance register, Requests & tickets, Team roster, HR desk, and the payroll rules gate. Employee details open from a native keyboard-operable button without overriding table semantics; result counts and form feedback use polite status regions.
- Java `EmployeeService` and `AttendanceService` with in-memory local fixtures; in Firebase mode the same Java services use user-scoped Firestore REST stores.
- Leave-request form with date/type validation and cancel action, plus ticket form with documented demo queue labels and cancel action. These workflows are explicitly browser-memory-only, clear on reload/sign-out, and never write Firestore or notify staff; there is no approval or authorization implementation.
- Read-only Team roster and HR directory views over the synthetic employee list. No team assignments, supervisor scope, employee edits, onboarding/offboarding, or sensitive PII are inferred or enabled.
- CSV export for currently visible synthetic employee results and loaded raw attendance rows. CSV cells are quoted and spreadsheet-formula prefixes are neutralized; exports contain no derived hours or payroll values.
- Server-side employee search/detail and inclusive raw-attendance date filtering for a selected employee. The date fields default to that employee's earliest/latest available records, following the earlier MO-IT108 Requirements Analysis; the user can narrow the range. This is not a payroll-period calendar. No paid hours, deductions, or pay are calculated.
- Firebase email/password sign-in and development-account creation UI; the UI stays behind the sign-in gate when Firebase config is complete.
- `/api/health`, employee list/search/detail, attendance query, and opt-in demo seed endpoint.
- Verification: `npm run test:web` runs 12 workflow/CSV safety tests (7 workflow, 5 CSV); `./test.sh` runs 67 Java checks; `npm run build` passes. Earlier foundation browser E2E covered Firebase sign-in, employee/attendance flows, and responsive layout. The new workflow UI has not yet had a successful browser E2E run in this continuation because the sandbox's Chromium launch is missing `libnspr4.so`; its domain logic and production build are verified, but the interactive browser flow still needs browser verification.

## Not implemented / important limits

- No production hosting, HR authorization roles, admin controls, audit trail, backup, or production security review. The built-in JDK HTTP server is a learning prototype, not a hardened public service.
- No live employee, attendance, or payroll information. Do not use this prototype for payroll processing.
- No work-hour derivation algorithm, payroll formulas, rates, pay-period calendar, payslips, or payroll calculations. The supplied material does not define a complete attendance algorithm or exact semi-monthly cut-offs, so the program will not infer them.
- Leave/ticket forms are session-only demonstrations, not persistent workflows. No approval actions, real routing, notification, audit trail, team assignments, employee edits, attendance imports, or approved source-system integration are implemented.
