  const apiPort = await freePort();
  const webPort = await freePort();
  const sources = readdirSync(sourceDir).filter(file => file.endsWith('.java')).map(file => path.join(sourceDir, file));
  execFileSync('javac', ['--add-modules', 'jdk.httpserver', '-cp', gsonJar, '-d', javaClasses, ...sources], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    stdio: 'inherit'
  });

  const apiEnv = {
    ...process.env,
    PORT: String(apiPort),
    HOST: '127.0.0.1',
    WEB_ROOT: path.join(projectRoot, 'web'),
    FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: ''
  };
  const api = start('java', ['--add-modules', 'jdk.httpserver', '-cp', `${gsonJar}:${javaClasses}`, 'ph.motorph.web.AppServer'], apiEnv, 'Java API');
  await waitForServer(`http://127.0.0.1:${apiPort}/api/health`, api, 'Java API');

  const webEnv = {
    ...process.env,
    API_PROXY_TARGET: `http://127.0.0.1:${apiPort}`,
    VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY: '',

    VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID: ''
  };
  const npm = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm';
  const vite = start(npm, ['run', 'dev', '--', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', String(webPort)], webEnv, 'Vite');
  const baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${webPort}`;
  const healthResponse = await waitForServer(`${baseUrl}/api/health`, vite, 'Vite/API proxy');
  const health = await healthResponse.json();
  assert.equal(health.mode, 'local-synthetic-demo', 'E2E must use isolated local process memory, not Firebase');

  try {
    browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage'] });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`Chromium could not launch. Install the Playwright browser and its system dependencies.\n${error.message}`);
  }
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1365, height: 900 } });
  const pageErrors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', error => pageErrors.push(error.message));

  console.log('PASS: local workspace loads the three synthetic fixture employees.');

  await page.locator('#employee-save-button').click();
  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.getElementById('employee-form-status').textContent.startsWith('Created DEMO-'), { timeout: timeoutMs });
  const createMessage = await page.locator('#employee-form-status').textContent();
  const employeeId = createMessage.match(/DEMO-[A-F0-9]{12}/)?.[0];

  await page.locator('#employee-edit-name').fill('Synthetic Browser E2E Updated');
  await page.locator('#employee-edit-location').fill('Makati');
  await page.locator('#employee-save-button').click();
  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.getElementById('employee-form-status').textContent.startsWith('Updated DEMO-'), { timeout: timeoutMs });

function populateWorkflowEmployees() {
  ['leave-employee', 'ticket-employee'].forEach(id => {
    const select = document.getElementById(id);
    const current = select.value;
    select.replaceChildren();
    const placeholder = document.createElement('option');
    placeholder.value = '';
    placeholder.textContent = state.allEmployees.length ? 'Choose synthetic employee' : 'Load directory first';
    select.append(placeholder);
    state.allEmployees.forEach(employee => {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = employee.id;
      option.textContent = `${employee.id} — ${employee.name}`;
      select.append(option);
    });
    if (state.allEmployees.some(employee => employee.id === current)) select.value = current;
  });
}

function showWorkflowTableMessage(tbody, columnCount, message) {
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  const row = document.createElement('tr');
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  cell.colSpan = columnCount;
  cell.className = 'table-message';
  cell.textContent = message;
  row.append(cell);
  tbody.append(row);
}

function makeWorkflowStatus(status) {
  const badge = document.createElement('span');
  badge.className = `status-pill${status === 'Cancelled' ? ' workflow-cancelled' : (status.toLowerCase() === 'active' ? '' : ' leave')}`;
  badge.textContent = status;
  return badge;
}

function makeCancelButton(action, item, employeeId, label) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.type = 'button';
  button.className = 'button button-quiet workflow-cancel';
  button.dataset.action = action;
  button.dataset.id = item.id;
  button.dataset.employeeId = employeeId;
  button.textContent = label;
  button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${label} ${item.id} for ${item.employeeName}`);
  return button;
}

function renderLeaveCalendar() {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('leave-calendar-grid');
  if (!tbody) return;
  const calendar = buildLeaveCalendar(leaveCalendarMonth, state.workflow.leaveRequests);
  document.getElementById('leave-calendar-month').textContent = calendar.title;
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  calendar.weeks.forEach(week => {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    week.forEach(day => {
      const cell = document.createElement('td');
      cell.className = `calendar-day${day.inMonth ? '' : ' outside-month'}${day.isToday ? ' today' : ''}`;
      if (!day.inMonth) {
        cell.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        row.append(cell);
        return;
      }
      cell.setAttribute('aria-label', `${day.date}${day.requests.length ? `, ${day.requests.length} request date${day.requests.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''}`);
      const dateNumber = document.createElement('span');
      dateNumber.className = 'calendar-date-number';
      dateNumber.textContent = String(day.day);
      cell.append(dateNumber);
      if (day.requests.length) {
        const list = document.createElement('ul');
        list.className = 'calendar-events';
        day.requests.forEach(request => {
          const event = document.createElement('li');
          event.className = `calendar-event${request.status === 'Cancelled' ? ' cancelled' : ''}`;
          event.textContent = `${request.leaveType} · ${request.status}`;
          event.title = `${request.employeeName} · ${request.employeeId} · request date only`;
          list.append(event);
        });
        cell.append(list);
      }
      row.append(cell);
    });
    tbody.append(row);
  });
}

function renderWorkflow() {
  if (!document.getElementById('leave-request-rows')) return;
  const leaveRows = document.getElementById('leave-request-rows');
  leaveRows.replaceChildren();
  if (!state.workflow.leaveRequests.length) {
    showWorkflowTableMessage(leaveRows, 6, 'No session requests yet.');
  } else {
    state.workflow.leaveRequests.forEach(request => {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      [request.id, `${request.employeeName} · ${request.employeeId}`, request.leaveType,
        `${request.startDate} — ${request.endDate}`].forEach(value => row.append(makeCell(value)));
      row.append(makeCell(makeWorkflowStatus(request.status)));
      row.append(makeCell(request.status === 'Pending review'
        ? makeCancelButton('cancel-leave', request, request.employeeId, 'Cancel') : '—'));
      leaveRows.append(row);
    });
  }
  const leaveCount = state.workflow.leaveRequests.length;
  document.getElementById('leave-request-count').textContent = `${leaveCount} ${leaveCount === 1 ? 'request' : 'requests'} in this sandbox`;

  const ticketRows = document.getElementById('ticket-rows');
  ticketRows.replaceChildren();
  if (!state.workflow.tickets.length) {
    showWorkflowTableMessage(ticketRows, 6, 'No session tickets yet.');
  } else {
    state.workflow.tickets.forEach(ticket => {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      [ticket.id, `${ticket.employeeName} · ${ticket.employeeId}`, ticket.ticketType, ticket.queue]
        .forEach(value => row.append(makeCell(value)));
      row.append(makeCell(makeWorkflowStatus(ticket.status)));
      row.append(makeCell(ticket.status === 'Open'
        ? makeCancelButton('cancel-ticket', ticket, ticket.employeeId, 'Cancel') : '—'));
      ticketRows.append(row);
    });
  }
  const ticketCount = state.workflow.tickets.length;
  document.getElementById('ticket-count').textContent = `${ticketCount} ${ticketCount === 1 ? 'ticket' : 'tickets'} in this sandbox`;
  document.getElementById('leave-export-button').disabled = leaveCount === 0;
  document.getElementById('ticket-export-button').disabled = ticketCount === 0;
  renderLeaveCalendar();
}

function setWorkflowStorageMode(value) {
  document.getElementById('workflow-storage-mode').textContent = value;
}

async function sendWorkflowRequest(url, body) {
  const headers = await apiHeaders(body === undefined ? {} : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  const options = { method: 'POST', headers };
  if (body !== undefined) options.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  const response = await fetch(url, options);
  const payload = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
  if (!payload || !payload.item) throw new Error('Unexpected workflow response.');
  return payload;
}

document.getElementById('employee-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const id = document.getElementById('employee-edit-id').value;
  const body = {
    name: document.getElementById('employee-edit-name').value,
    department: document.getElementById('employee-edit-department').value,
    role: document.getElementById('employee-edit-role').value,
    location: document.getElementById('employee-edit-location').value,
    status: document.getElementById('employee-edit-status').value
  };
  const button = document.getElementById('employee-save-button');
  button.disabled = true;
  try {
    const headers = await apiHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    const response = await fetch(id ? `/api/employees/${encodeURIComponent(id)}` : '/api/employees', {
      method: id ? 'PUT' : 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    const employeeId = payload.item && payload.item.id;
    resetEmployeeEditor();
    search.value = '';
    await loadEmployees();
    setWorkflowStatus('employee-form-status', `${id ? 'Updated' : 'Created'} ${employeeId || 'synthetic record'} in ${state.user ? 'your user-scoped Firestore sandbox' : 'shared local API-process memory'}. No schedule mapping was added.`);
  } catch (error) {
    setWorkflowStatus('employee-form-status', error.message || 'Could not save this synthetic record.', true);
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
});

document.getElementById('employee-cancel-edit-button').addEventListener('click', resetEmployeeEditor);

document.getElementById('leave-request-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const form = event.currentTarget;
  const employeeId = document.getElementById('leave-employee').value;
  const input = {
    employeeId,
    leaveType: document.getElementById('leave-type').value,
    startDate: document.getElementById('leave-start').value,
    endDate: document.getElementById('leave-end').value,
    note: document.getElementById('leave-note').value
  };
  const button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
  button.disabled = true;
  try {
    submitLeaveRequest(createWorkflowState(), input, state.allEmployees);
    const payload = await sendWorkflowRequest('/api/workflows/leave', input);
    const [year, month] = input.startDate.split('-').map(Number);
    leaveCalendarMonth = new Date(year, month - 1, 1);
    applyWorkflowItem('leaveRequests', payload.item, payload.storage);
    form.reset();
    document.getElementById('leave-employee').value = employeeId;
    const storage = payload.storage === 'user-scoped-firestore' ? 'saved to your user sandbox' : 'saved in local server memory';
    setWorkflowStatus('leave-form-status', `${payload.item.id} ${storage}. No reviewer was notified.`);
  } catch (error) {
    setWorkflowStatus('leave-form-status', error.message || 'Could not create this demo request.', true);
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
});

  event.preventDefault();
  const form = event.currentTarget;
  const employeeId = document.getElementById('ticket-employee').value;

    const payload = await sendWorkflowRequest('/api/workflows/tickets', input);

    form.reset();
    document.getElementById('ticket-employee').value = employeeId;
    const storage = payload.storage === 'user-scoped-firestore' ? 'saved to your user sandbox' : 'saved in local server memory';
    setWorkflowStatus('ticket-form-status', `${payload.item.id} ${storage}; queue label ${payload.item.queue}, not delivered.`);
  } catch (error) {
    setWorkflowStatus('ticket-form-status', error.message || 'Could not create this demo ticket.', true);
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
});

async function handleWorkflowCancel(event) {
  const button = event.target.closest('button[data-action]');
  if (!button) return;
  const isLeave = button.dataset.action === 'cancel-leave';
  const formStatus = isLeave ? 'leave-form-status' : 'ticket-form-status';
  const collection = isLeave ? 'leaveRequests' : 'tickets';
  button.disabled = true;
  try {
    const payload = await sendWorkflowRequest(`/api/workflows/${isLeave ? 'leave' : 'tickets'}/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id)}/cancel`);
    applyWorkflowItem(collection, payload.item, payload.storage);
    setWorkflowStatus(formStatus, `${button.dataset.id} cancelled in this user sandbox. No reviewer was notified.`);
  } catch (error) {
    setWorkflowStatus(formStatus, error.message || 'Could not cancel this demo item.', true);
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}

document.getElementById('leave-request-rows').addEventListener('click', handleWorkflowCancel);
document.getElementById('ticket-rows').addEventListener('click', handleWorkflowCancel);

  assert.deepEqual(filterWorkflowItems(null), []);

workflow-filter.js
JS
export function filterWorkflowItems(items, { query = '', status = '', searchFields = [] } = {}) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
  const needle = String(query || '').trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  const selectedStatus = String(status || '').trim();
  const fields = Array.isArray(searchFields) ? searchFields : [];
  return items.filter(item => {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return false;
    if (selectedStatus && item.status !== selectedStatus) return false;
    if (!needle) return true;
    return fields.some(field => {
      const value = item[field];
      return value !== null && value !== undefined && String(value).toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle);
    });
  });
}

# i-have-adhd

The reader has ADHD. Output is not just brief. It is shaped so an ADHD brain can act on it.

## Persistence

These rules apply to every response for the rest of the session, not only this one. They do not expire after a few turns and they do not lapse when the topic changes. If you are unsure whether they still apply, they do.

Turn them off only when the reader says "stop adhd mode" or "normal mode". Confirm in one line, then return to your default style.

## What ADHD changes about reading

Five facts drive every rule below:

1. Working memory is small. Anything not on screen is forgotten. Do not ask the reader to "keep in mind X."
2. Knowing the answer is not doing the answer. The friction between "got it" and "done it" is where work dies.
3. Starting is the hardest step. The first action must be obvious, small, and doable now.
4. Time estimates feel uniform. "A bit of work" and "a few hours" register the same. Vague estimates fail.
5. Dopamine is scarce. Visible progress matters. Buried wins do not register.

## Rules

### 1. Lead with the next action

The first line is something the reader can do. Not context. Not a plan. The action.

Bad: "Let's think about this. Your auth flow has a few moving pieces..."
Good: "Edit `src/auth.ts:42` to update the token validation."

If the answer is a command, path, or snippet, it goes first. Prose comes after, if at all.

### 2. Number multi-step tasks

If the work takes more than one step, write a numbered list. Each step is one bounded action. No step contains "and then" twice.

Use the fewest steps that still work. Cut any step the reader does not need, and fold trivial steps into the one before. A short path finished beats a complete path abandoned.

Bad: "First open the file, find the function, swap it out, then run the tests."

Good:
```
1. Open `src/auth.ts`
2. Replace `verifyToken` (lines 42 to 58) with the snippet below
3. Run `npm test -- auth.spec.ts`
```

### 3. End with one concrete next action

If anything is left open, name ONE thing the reader can do in under two minutes. Even "open the file" counts.

Bad: "Hope that helps. Let me know if you want to dig deeper."
Good: "Next: run `npm test` and paste the first failing line."

### 4. Suppress tangents

If a second issue exists, finish the first, then offer the second as a separate question.

Bad: "Here's the fix. By the way, your dependency is also stale, and your README is out of date, and..."
Good: "Here's the fix. Separately: there is also a stale dependency. Want me to handle that next?"

A question that comes up mid-work is not a tangent: answer it yourself if you can and fold the result in. If it still needs the reader, surface it once, at the end.

### 5. Restate state every turn

The reader cannot hold "we are on step 3 of 5" between messages. Restate it.

Bad: "Done. Ready for the next part?"
Good: "Step 3 of 5 done: schema updated. Next: backfill the new column. Run the script?"

If the harness has a task or plan tool, use it for multi-step work: one item per step, one in progress at a time. The checklist does the restating; do not also narrate the full plan as prose.

### 6. Give specific time estimates

Vague estimates fail. Ballpark in concrete units.

Bad: "This will take some work."
Good: "About 15 minutes if tests already cover this. An afternoon if not."

### 7. Make completed work visible

Show what now works, in concrete terms. Do not bury wins in a recap.

Bad: "I've made some changes to the auth flow. Among other things..."
Good: "Login now works with magic links. Try: `npm run dev`, open `/login`."

### 8. Matter-of-fact tone for errors

Never use "Uh oh," "Oh no," or "There seems to be a problem." State cause and fix.

Bad: "Uh oh, the test is failing. There seems to be an issue..."
Good: "Test fails at `auth.spec.ts:42`: expected 200, got 401. Cause: missing auth header. Fix: add `Authorization: Bearer ${token}` to the request."

### 9. Cap lists to 5 items

For long lists in the final response, group related items and rank the most relevant first. Keep the visible working set small: aim for no more than five items per group. When more items are relevant, retain them internally without discarding them. Display them only when the user asks or when they become the next items to address.

Never omit relevant items when completeness matters. This rule shapes presentation only; it must not limit analysis, search, tool results, candidate generation, or retained information.

### 10. No preamble, no recap, no closing pleasantries

Forbidden openers: "Great question," "Let me...", "I'll...", "Sure!", "Looking at your...", "To answer your question..."

Forbidden recaps after a completed task: "I've now done X, Y, and Z, which means..."

Forbidden closers: "Let me know if you need anything else," "Hope this helps," "Happy to clarify," "Feel free to ask."

Start with the answer. End when the answer is done.

## When to break the rules

Override the defaults when:

1. User asks to "explain" or "walk me through." Explain fully. Still no preamble, still no closer, but the body runs as long as the topic needs. Add headers so the reader can skim back.
2. Destructive action ahead (`rm -rf`, force push, schema migration, dropping a table). Confirm before acting. Safety wins over brevity.
3. Debug spiral. If the last three turns have been "still broken," stop iterating on code. Name the assumption that might be wrong. Ask one diagnostic question.
4. Real ambiguity in the request. One short clarifying question beats guessing and rewriting.
5. A rule fights the task. When a rule would delete the answer itself, the task wins; the shape stays. Example: "what are my options" gets 2 to 4 ranked options with one-line trade-offs, recommendation first, not one path. The options are the answer.
6. A rule fights the harness. Inside an agent harness, the system prompt outranks this skill: announce a tool call when the harness requires it, do the work instead of asking "want me to," point time estimates at whoever executes the steps. Same principle as 5: the constraint wins, the shape stays.

## Pre-send check

Before sending, delete:

1. The first sentence if it announces what you are about to do.
2. The last sentence if it asks "anything else?" or recaps what just happened.
3. Any "by the way" sidebar.
4. Any hedging adverb adding no information ("perhaps," "might," "could possibly"). Keep a hedge that carries real uncertainty; deleting it manufactures confidence.
5. Any idiom or figurative phrase ("circle back," "get the ball rolling," "on the same page"). Replace with the literal action.

Then verify: if the reader reads only the first line and the last line, do they know (a) what to do next, and (b) what just happened?

If yes, send.

**Structure and flow:** `Main.main()` starts the Swing login. On successful login, `initializeApplication()` constructs a `DataRepository`, loads employees and attendance, then wires `EmployeeService`, `PayrollService`, `ReportService` to their controllers and gives those controllers to `MainFrame`. ## Folder 6 — explicit MO-IT110 MS2 refactor example

**Location:** `6/-/`. Its README names MO-IT110 OOP Milestone 2 and says the project refactors a CP2 Java Swing app into an approved MS1 design. It has 22 production Java files under `src/motorph/`, 10 plain-Java tests under `test/motorph/`, CSV data, CP2 reference outputs, NetBeans metadata and an Ant build file. The declared main class is `motorph.MotorPH`.

**Structure and flow:** `MotorPH` opens `LoginFrame`. UI classes are under `ui/`; the payroll domain is separated into `model/`, `deduction/`, `service/` and `user/`.

1. `CSVDataHandler` loads employees and attendance from CSV and creates model objects.
2. `Employee` is an abstract class; `RegularEmployee` and `ProbationaryEmployee` supply subtype behavior such as allowances.
3. `AttendanceRecord` calculates hours/cutoff membership.
4. `PayrollProcessor` accepts a list of `Deduction` objects (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and tax), totals cutoff hours, calculates gross/deductions/net, and creates an immutable `Payslip`.
5. UI frames display employee/payroll results and save payroll CSV output.
6. `User`, `EmployeeUser` and `PayrollStaff` demonstrate authentication/role permissions for the employee-lookup vs staff screens.

The README says the implementation preserves CP2's cutoff behavior and describes how it rounds money, applies deductions and lists allowances. It also cautions that the salary tables/rules were carried from CP2 rather than independently verified against a current MotorPH/government specification. The README reports 167 checks and 0 failures, with CP2 comparison differences on 3 of 476 rows; those are project-reported results, not runs performed in this review.

**Course connection:** direct MS2 relevance by its own README; the code is a concrete example of implementing an approved design, using encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism and a view/backend split. The CP2 source commit and authorship/permission should be confirmed before adopting any code or presenting it as the user's work.

## Folder 7 — Swing/CSV payroll app with unclear submission identity

**Location:** `7/-/src/motorphpayrollsystem/`. There are 35 Java files, NetBeans forms/assets, and bundled OpenCSV, Commons Lang and AbsoluteLayout libraries. There is no README, no course/team label, and no CSV data file in the folder. The project main class is `MotorPHPayrollSystem`.

**Structure and flow:** the main class tries to create `attendance.csv`, loads employee data through `EmployeeData`, and opens `loginUI`. Login looks up an employee row in a CSV and compares a password against column 20. On success it opens `DashboardUI`. `EmployeeData` keeps the CSV rows in a static shared list and offers add/update/delete/profile methods that rewrite the CSV. The UI includes employee dashboard/profile, attendance clock-in/clock-out and history, employee records, admin employee add/update/delete, payroll screens and a bulk-payroll/export screen. `Attendance` and `CSVUtil` provide CSV persistence; `Payroll`, `ContributionCalculator`, `PayrollCalculator` and `PayrollProcessor` contain pay logic; `FullTimeEmployee`/`PartTimeEmployee` and `EmployeeMapper` provide model objects.

## Folder 8 — MO-IT103 Group 18 console + Swing project

**Location:** `8/-/MO-IT103-Group18-master/MO-IT103-Group18-master/`. There are 36 Java files under `Backend/`, `Console/`, `GUI/` and one top-level labels file, plus NetBeans/Ant metadata, JARs and three local CSV datasets (employee details, attendance and credentials). No README is included.

**Two front ends use the data differently:**

- `Console.TACP2` is a terminal workflow: login with employee number/last name; view profile, daily attendance, weekly hours and payroll. It downloads published Google Sheets CSV over HTTP, so it depends on internet access and the sheet schema.
- The Swing UI starts from `GUI.LogIn` and proceeds to `GUI.MainMenu`. It uses the bundled local CSVs and has profile, attendance, payroll, employee table and employee add/update/delete screens.

The `Backend/` package contains employee/attendance records, CSV loading, payroll processors (regular, final-pay and 13th-month variants), statutory deduction calculators, regular/holiday overtime classes, plus leave and payslip-dispute domain classes. The regular payroll processor uses attendance totals and a `Payslip`; deduction types are separate classes. The GUI exposes employee dispute submission and a payroll-side review/resolve/reject frame.

**Caveats:** leave records shown by the GUI are explicitly hard-coded sample rows because there is no leave data file. Payslip disputes live in a singleton in-memory list, not persistent storage, so the records disappear on process exit. The payroll-side dispute frame itself notes role authorization is not implemented. The console path fetches external sheets; the GUI path reads local data—do not confuse them as one identical data flow. This is a CP2-labeled comparison project, not an MS1-approved design by evidence in this folder.

package ph.motorph.web;

/** Synthetic leave request stored only in a user's development sandbox. */
public final class DemoLeaveRequest {
    private final String id;
    private final String employeeId;
    private final String employeeName;
    private final String leaveType;
    private final String startDate;
    private final String endDate;
    private final String note;
    private final String status;
    private final String submittedAt;
    private final String cancelledAt;

    public DemoLeaveRequest(String id, String employeeId, String employeeName, String leaveType,
            String startDate, String endDate, String note, String status, String submittedAt, String cancelledAt) {
        this.id = id;
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.employeeName = employeeName;
        this.leaveType = leaveType;
        this.startDate = startDate;
        this.endDate = endDate;
        this.note = note;
        this.status = status;
        this.submittedAt = submittedAt;
        this.cancelledAt = cancelledAt == null ? "" : cancelledAt;
    }

    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelled(String timestamp) {
        return new DemoLeaveRequest(id, employeeId, employeeName, leaveType, startDate, endDate,
            note, "Cancelled", submittedAt, timestamp);

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Firestore user-subcollection adapter. Firestore Rules enforce owner-only access. */
public final class FirestoreWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private static final String LEAVE_COLLECTION = "demoLeaveRequests";
    private static final String TICKET_COLLECTION = "demoTickets";
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreWorkflowStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        List<DemoLeaveRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION))) {
            requests.add(leaveFromDocument(document));
        }
        requests.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoLeaveRequest::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return requests;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), request.getId(), leaveFields(request))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest current = listLeaveRequests().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Pending review".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        List<DemoTicket> tickets = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION))) {
            tickets.add(ticketFromDocument(document));
        }
        tickets.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoTicket::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return tickets;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), ticket.getId(), ticketFields(ticket))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket current = listTickets().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Open".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    private static JsonObject leaveFields(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(request.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(request.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employeeName", stringField(request.getEmployeeName()));
        fields.add("leaveType", stringField(request.getLeaveType()));
        fields.add("startDate", stringField(request.getStartDate()));
        fields.add("endDate", stringField(request.getEndDate()));
        fields.add("note", stringField(request.getNote()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(request.getStatus()));
        fields.add("submittedAt", timestampField(request.getSubmittedAt()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject ticketFields(DemoTicket ticket) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(ticket.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(ticket.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employeeName", stringField(ticket.getEmployeeName()));
        fields.add("ticketType", stringField(ticket.getTicketType()));
        fields.add("queue", stringField(ticket.getQueue()));
        fields.add("summary", stringField(ticket.getSummary()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(ticket.getStatus()));
        fields.add("submittedAt", timestampField(ticket.getSubmittedAt()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static DemoLeaveRequest leaveFromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = fields(document);
        return new DemoLeaveRequest(documentId(document), value(fields, "employeeId"), value(fields, "employeeName"),
            value(fields, "leaveType"), value(fields, "startDate"), value(fields, "endDate"), value(fields, "note"),
            value(fields, "status"), dateTimeValue(fields, "submittedAt"), dateTimeValue(fields, "cancelledAt"));
    }

    private static DemoTicket ticketFromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = fields(document);
        return new DemoTicket(documentId(document), value(fields, "employeeId"), value(fields, "employeeName"),
            value(fields, "ticketType"), value(fields, "queue"), value(fields, "summary"), value(fields, "status"),
            dateTimeValue(fields, "submittedAt"), dateTimeValue(fields, "cancelledAt"));
    }

    private static JsonObject fields(JsonObject document) {
        return document.has("fields") && document.get("fields").isJsonObject()
            ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
    }

    private static String documentId(JsonObject document) {
        String name = document.has("name") ? document.get("name").getAsString() : "";
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash < 0 || slash == name.length() - 1) throw new IllegalStateException("Firestore workflow document has no ID.");
        return name.substring(slash + 1);
    }

    private static String value(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonObject typed = element.getAsJsonObject();
        if (typed.has("stringValue")) return typed.get("stringValue").getAsString();
        if (typed.has("timestampValue")) return typed.get("timestampValue").getAsString();
        return "";
    }

    private static String dateTimeValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return fields.has(name) ? value(fields, name) : "";
    }

    private static JsonObject stringField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return field;
    }

    private static JsonObject timestampField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("timestampValue", value);
        return field;
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.UUID;

/** Validates and coordinates safe, non-payroll workflow demonstrations. */
public final class WorkflowService {
    private static final int MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 240;
    private static final List<String> LEAVE_TYPES = Collections.unmodifiableList(
        Arrays.asList("Vacation", "Medical", "Personal", "Unpaid"));
    private static final Map<String, String> TICKET_QUEUES;
    static {
        Map<String, String> queues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        queues.put("Overtime request", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Leave request", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Timesheet correction", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Payroll inquiry", "Payroll Staff");
        queues.put("HR inquiry", "HR");
        queues.put("Technical support", "IT Admin");
        TICKET_QUEUES = Collections.unmodifiableMap(queues);
    }

    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final WorkflowStore store;

    public WorkflowService(EmployeeService employeeService, WorkflowStore store) {
        if (employeeService == null || store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("workflow dependencies must not be null");
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() { return store.listLeaveRequests(); }
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() { return store.listTickets(); }

    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(String employeeId, String leaveType,
            String startDate, String endDate, String note) {
        Employee employee = requireEmployee(employeeId);
        if (!LEAVE_TYPES.contains(leaveType)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a valid leave type.");
        LocalDate start = parseDate(startDate, "start date");
        LocalDate end = parseDate(endDate, "end date");
        if (start.isAfter(end)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The start date must be on or before the end date.");
        String safeNote = optionalText(note, "Note");
        String id = "LV-" + randomSuffix();
        return store.createLeaveRequest(new DemoLeaveRequest(id, employee.getId(), employee.getName(), leaveType,
            start.toString(), end.toString(), safeNote, "Pending review", Instant.now().toString(), ""));
    }

    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id) {
        requireId(id, "LV-");
        return store.cancelLeaveRequest(id, Instant.now().toString());
    }

    public DemoTicket createTicket(String employeeId, String ticketType, String summary) {
        Employee employee = requireEmployee(employeeId);
        String queue = TICKET_QUEUES.get(ticketType);
        if (queue == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a valid ticket type.");
        String safeSummary = requiredText(summary, "Message");
        String id = "TK-" + randomSuffix();
        return store.createTicket(new DemoTicket(id, employee.getId(), employee.getName(), ticketType, queue,
            safeSummary, "Open", Instant.now().toString(), ""));
    }

    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id) {
        requireId(id, "TK-");
        return store.cancelTicket(id, Instant.now().toString());
    }

    private Employee requireEmployee(String employeeId) {
        String id = requiredText(employeeId, "Employee ID");
        return employeeService.findEmployee(id).orElseThrow(() ->
            new NoSuchElementException("Choose an employee from your synthetic demo directory."));
    }

    private static LocalDate parseDate(String value, String field) {
        String text = requiredText(value, field);
        try {
            LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(text);
            if (!date.toString().equals(text)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD " + field + ".");
            return date;
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD " + field + ".");
        }
    }

    private static String requiredText(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " is required.");
        if (text.length() > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be " + MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + " characters or fewer.");
        return text;
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Process-memory store used only by the unauthenticated local synthetic preview. */
public final class InMemoryWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private final Map<String, DemoLeaveRequest> leaveRequests = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, DemoTicket> tickets = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public synchronized List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        return new ArrayList<>(leaveRequests.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (leaveRequests.containsKey(request.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists.");
        leaveRequests.put(request.getId(), request);
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest existing = leaveRequests.get(id);
        if (existing == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found.");
        if (!"Pending review".equals(existing.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        DemoLeaveRequest cancelled = existing.cancelled(cancelledAt);
        leaveRequests.put(id, cancelled);
        return cancelled;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        return new ArrayList<>(tickets.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (tickets.containsKey(ticket.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists.");
        tickets.put(ticket.getId(), ticket);
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket existing = tickets.get(id);
        if (existing == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found.");
        if (!"Open".equals(existing.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        DemoTicket cancelled = existing.cancelled(cancelledAt);
        tickets.put(id, cancelled);
        return cancelled;
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Domain checks for owner-sandbox workflow validation and state transitions. */
public final class WorkflowServiceTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        createsAndCancelsFictionalLeaveRequests();
        rejectsInvalidLeaveRequestsAndIDs();
        routesSyntheticTicketsAndEnforcesCancellationLifecycle();
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " workflow-domain checks");
    }

    private static void createsAndCancelsFictionalLeaveRequests() {
        InMemoryWorkflowStore store = new InMemoryWorkflowStore();
        WorkflowService service = service(store);
        DemoLeaveRequest request = service.createLeaveRequest("DEMO-001", "Vacation",
            "2026-11-10", "2026-11-11", "Fictional request");
        check(request.getId().matches("LV-[A-F0-9]{12}"), "server-generated leave ID has safe format");
        check("Mara Rivera".equals(request.getEmployeeName()), "employee name comes from the synthetic directory");
        check("Pending review".equals(request.getStatus()), "new request starts pending review");
        check("2026-11-10".equals(request.getStartDate()) && "2026-11-11".equals(request.getEndDate()), "leave date range preserved");
        check(store.listLeaveRequests().size() == 1, "created leave request is stored");
        DemoLeaveRequest cancelled = service.cancelLeaveRequest(request.getId());
        check("Cancelled".equals(cancelled.getStatus()) && !cancelled.getCancelledAt().isEmpty(), "cancel records status and timestamp");
        check("Cancelled".equals(store.listLeaveRequests().get(0).getStatus()), "cancelled status persists in store");
    }

    private static void rejectsInvalidLeaveRequestsAndIDs() {
        WorkflowService service = service(new InMemoryWorkflowStore());
        expectIllegal(() -> service.createLeaveRequest("DEMO-001", "Vacation", "2026-02-30", "2026-03-01", ""),
            "impossible date rejected");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.createLeaveRequest("DEMO-001", "Vacation", "2026-11-12", "2026-11-11", ""),
            "reversed range rejected");
        expectNotFound(() -> service.createLeaveRequest("DEMO-999", "Vacation", "2026-11-10", "2026-11-11", ""),
            "employee must exist in the synthetic directory");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.createLeaveRequest("DEMO-001", "Unapproved", "2026-11-10", "2026-11-11", ""),
            "unsupported leave type rejected");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.createLeaveRequest("DEMO-001", "Vacation", "2026-11-10", "2026-11-11", "x".repeat(241)),
            "overlong note rejected");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.cancelLeaveRequest("../outside"), "path-like request ID rejected");
        expectNotFound(() -> service.cancelLeaveRequest("LV-FFFFFFFFFFFF"), "missing request returns not found");
    }

    private static void routesSyntheticTicketsAndEnforcesCancellationLifecycle() {
        InMemoryWorkflowStore store = new InMemoryWorkflowStore();
        WorkflowService service = service(store);
        Map<String, String> routes = new HashMap<>();
        routes.put("Overtime request", "Team Lead");
        routes.put("Leave request", "Team Lead");
        routes.put("Timesheet correction", "Team Lead");
        routes.put("Payroll inquiry", "Payroll Staff");
        routes.put("HR inquiry", "HR");
        routes.put("Technical support", "IT Admin");
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> route : routes.entrySet()) {
            DemoTicket ticket = service.createTicket("DEMO-002", route.getKey(), "Synthetic test message");
            check(route.getValue().equals(ticket.getQueue()), "ticket queue label maps for " + route.getKey());
            check("Open".equals(ticket.getStatus()), "new ticket status is Open");
        }
        DemoTicket ticket = store.listTickets().get(0);
        DemoTicket cancelled = service.cancelTicket(ticket.getId());
        check("Cancelled".equals(cancelled.getStatus()), "open ticket can be cancelled");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.cancelTicket(ticket.getId()), "cancelled ticket cannot be cancelled again");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.createTicket("DEMO-001", "Payroll payout", "No calculation"), "unsupported ticket type rejected");
        expectIllegal(() -> service.createTicket("DEMO-001", "HR inquiry", "  "), "empty ticket message rejected");
    }

    private static WorkflowService service(WorkflowStore store) {
        return new WorkflowService(new EmployeeService(new InMemoryEmployeeStore()), store);
    }

    private static void expectIllegal(Runnable action, String message) {
        try {
            action.run();
            throw new AssertionError(message);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException expected) {
            check(true, message);
        }
    }

    private static void expectNotFound(Runnable action, String message) {
        try {
            action.run();
            throw new AssertionError(message);
        } catch (NoSuchElementException expected) {
            check(true, message);
        }
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
}

async function loadEmployees() {
  const requestNumber = ++state.requestNumber;
  const query = search.value.trim();
  showTableMessage('Loading employee records…');
  resultCount.textContent = 'Loading';
  try {
    const url = query ? `/api/employees?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : '/api/employees';
    const response = await fetch(url, { headers: await apiHeaders() });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.items)) throw new Error('Unexpected employee response');
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = payload.items;
    state.totalEmployees = Number.isInteger(payload.total) ? payload.total : payload.items.length;
    if (!query) {
      state.allEmployees = payload.items;
      populateAttendanceEmployees();
      populateWorkflowEmployees();
      renderDirectoryViews();
    }
    seedDemoButton.hidden = !(state.user && state.totalEmployees === 0 && !query);
    renderEmployees();
  } catch (error) {
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = [];
    state.allEmployees = [];
    seedDemoButton.hidden = true;
    populateAttendanceEmployees();
    populateWorkflowEmployees();
    renderDirectoryViews();
    renderEmployees();
    showTableMessage(error.message || 'Could not reach the Java service. Check that the prototype server is running, then refresh.');
    resultCount.textContent = 'Could not load records';
  }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Employee use cases, separated from HTTP handling and the storage implementation. */
public final class EmployeeService {
    private final EmployeeStore store;

    public EmployeeService(EmployeeStore store) {
        if (store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("store must not be null");
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<Employee> listEmployees() {
        return store.findAll();
    }

    public Optional<Employee> findEmployee(String id) {
        return store.findById(id == null ? null : id.trim());
    }

    /** Creates a fictional directory record inside the current owner's sandbox only. */
    public Employee createEmployee(String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        MutableEmployeeStore mutable = mutableStore();
        Employee employee = validatedEmployee("DEMO-" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")
            .substring(0, 12).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT), name, department, role, location, status);
        return mutable.create(employee);
    }

    /** Updates only fields present in the synthetic directory model; no payroll/PII fields exist here. */
    public Employee updateEmployee(String id, String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        String safeId = id == null ? "" : id.trim();
        if (!safeId.matches("DEMO-(?:[0-9]{3}|[A-F0-9]{12})")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Employee ID is invalid.");
        if (!findEmployee(safeId).isPresent()) throw new NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
        return mutableStore().update(validatedEmployee(safeId, name, department, role, location, status));
    }

    private MutableEmployeeStore mutableStore() {
        if (!(store instanceof MutableEmployeeStore)) throw new IllegalStateException("This employee store is read-only.");
        return (MutableEmployeeStore) store;
    }

    private static Employee validatedEmployee(String id, String name, String department,
            String role, String location, String status) {
        return new Employee(id, requiredDirectoryText(name, "Name"), requiredDirectoryText(department, "Department"),
            requiredDirectoryText(role, "Role"), requiredDirectoryText(location, "Location"), validStatus(status));
    }

    private static String requiredDirectoryText(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " is required.");
        if (text.length() > 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be 100 characters or fewer.");
        return text;
    }

    private static String validStatus(String value) {
        String status = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (!"Active".equals(status) && !"On leave".equals(status)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Status must be Active or On leave.");
        }
        return status;
    }

    /** Empty query returns all; search is case-insensitive across the displayed fields. */
    public List<Employee> searchEmployees(String query) {
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) return store.findAll();
        String normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return store.findAll().stream()
            .filter(employee -> searchableText(employee).contains(normalized))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private String searchableText(Employee employee) {
        return (employee.getId() + " " + employee.getName() + " " + employee.getDepartment() + " "
            + employee.getRole() + " " + employee.getLocation() + " " + employee.getStatus())
            .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.Objects;

/** A small employee view model for the first synthetic-data prototype. */
public final class Employee {
    private final String id;
    private final String name;
    private final String department;
    private final String role;
    private final String location;
    private final String status;

    public Employee(String id, String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        this.id = requireText(id, "id");
        this.name = requireText(name, "name");
        this.department = requireText(department, "department");
        this.role = requireText(role, "role");
        this.location = requireText(location, "location");
        this.status = requireText(status, "status");
    }

    private static String requireText(String value, String field) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, field + " must not be null");
        if (value.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must not be blank");
        return value.trim();
    }

    public String getId() { return id; }
    public String getName() { return name; }
    public String getDepartment() { return department; }
    public String getRole() { return role; }
    public String getLocation() { return location; }
    public String getStatus() { return status; }
}

function switchView(view) {
  const labels = { overview: 'Overview', employees: 'Employees', attendance: 'Attendance', requests: 'Requests & tickets', team: 'Team roster', hr: 'HR operations', payroll: 'Payroll' };
  if (!labels[view]) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.page-view').forEach(page => {
    page.hidden = page.id !== `${view}-view`;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(nav => {
    const active = nav.dataset.view === view;
    nav.classList.toggle('active', active);
    if (active) nav.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    else nav.removeAttribute('aria-current');
  });
  document.getElementById('crumb-current').textContent = labels[view];
  document.title = `${labels[view]} — MotorPH Payroll Office`;
  if (view === 'attendance' && attendanceEmployee.value) loadAttendance();
}

document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
  item.addEventListener('click', () => switchView(item.dataset.view));
});

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Small Firestore REST client that forwards a Firebase Auth ID token. Firestore
 * Security Rules, not server credentials, authorize every read and write.
 */
public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String apiRoot;
    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    /** Package-private endpoint override for isolated HTTP contract tests. */
    FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {

const authError = document.getElementById('auth-error');

function setAuthError(message) {
  authError.textContent = message;
  authError.hidden = !message;
}

function friendlyAuthError(error) {
  const code = error && error.code || '';
  if (code === 'auth/operation-not-allowed') return 'Email/Password sign-in is disabled. Enable it in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.';
  if (code === 'auth/unauthorized-domain') return 'This preview domain is not authorized. Add its host under Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, or test on localhost.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-api-key' || code === 'auth/api-key-not-valid.-please-pass-a-valid-api-key.') return 'The Firebase Web API key in .env.local is missing or invalid.';
  if (code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') return 'That email already has a Firebase account. Use Sign in instead.';
  if (code === 'auth/weak-password') return 'Use a password with at least six characters.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-email') return 'Enter a valid email address.';
  if (code === 'auth/too-many-requests') return 'Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || code === 'auth/wrong-password' || code === 'auth/user-not-found') return 'Email or password is incorrect.';
  return error && error.message ? error.message : 'Firebase sign-in could not be completed.';
}

async function signIn() {
  setAuthError('');
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-status').textContent = '';
  try {
    await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, authEmail.value.trim(), authPassword.value);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
  }
}

async function createDevAccount() {
  setAuthError('');
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-status').textContent = '';
  try {
    await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, authEmail.value.trim(), authPassword.value);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
  }
}

async function sendPasswordReset() {
  setAuthError('');
  const status = document.getElementById('auth-reset-status');
  const button = document.getElementById('password-reset-button');
  status.textContent = '';
  if (!authEmail.value.trim() || !authEmail.checkValidity()) {
    authEmail.reportValidity();
    return;
  }
  button.disabled = true;
  status.textContent = '';
  try {
    await sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, authEmail.value.trim());
    status.textContent = 'If an account exists for that email, Firebase will send a reset link.';
  } catch (error) {
    if (error && ['auth/user-not-found', 'auth/user-disabled'].includes(error.code)) {
      status.textContent = 'If an account exists for that email, Firebase will send a reset link.';
    } else {
      setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
    }
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}

/** Java 11 HTTP backend for the browser-based MotorPH prototype. */
public final class AppServer {
    private final Path webRoot;
    private final String firebaseProjectId;
    private final String firestoreApiRoot;
    private final EmployeeService localEmployeeService = new EmployeeService(new InMemoryEmployeeStore());
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore localScheduleStore = new InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore();
    private final AttendanceStore localAttendanceStore = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();
    private final WorkflowStore localWorkflowStore = new InMemoryWorkflowStore();
    private HttpServer server;
    private java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService executor;

    public AppServer() {
        this(System.getenv().getOrDefault("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID", ""),
            Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("WEB_ROOT", "web")), null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot) {
        this(firebaseProjectId, webRoot, null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot) {
        this.firebaseProjectId = firebaseProjectId == null ? "" : firebaseProjectId.trim();
        if (webRoot == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("webRoot must not be null");
        this.webRoot = webRoot.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.firestoreApiRoot = firestoreApiRoot == null || firestoreApiRoot.trim().isEmpty()
            ? null : firestoreApiRoot.trim();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        int port = Integer.parseInt(System.getenv().getOrDefault("PORT", "8080"));
        String host = System.getenv().getOrDefault("HOST", "0.0.0.0");
        AppServer app = new AppServer();
        app.start(host, port);
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(app::stop));
    }

    HttpServer start(String host, int port) throws IOException {
        if (server != null) throw new IllegalStateException("server is already started");
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(host, port), 0);
        server.createContext("/api/health", this::handleHealth);
        server.createContext("/api/employees", this::handleEmployees);
        server.createContext("/api/attendance", this::handleAttendance);
        server.createContext("/api/workflows", this::handleWorkflows);
        server.createContext("/api/demo/seed", this::handleSeedDemo);
        server.createContext("/", this::handleStaticFiles);
        executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        server.setExecutor(executor);
        server.start();
        System.out.println("MotorPH Java API listening on " + host + ":" + server.getAddress().getPort());
        System.out.println("Mode: " + (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local synthetic demo" : "Firebase-authenticated user sandbox"));
        System.out.println("Serving browser files from " + webRoot);
        return server;
    }

    void stop() {
        if (server != null) {
            server.stop(0);
            server = null;
        }
        if (executor != null) {
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor = null;
        }
    }

async function apiHeaders(extra = {}) {
  const headers = { Accept: 'application/json', ...extra };
  if (state.user) {
    const token = await state.user.getIdToken();
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    headers['X-Firebase-UID'] = state.user.uid;
  }
  return headers;
}

## Firebase development sandbox

- `.env.local` contains the Firebase **Web** app config used by the browser SDK; `.gitignore` lists this file. The user-supplied Web API key for `motorph-jd` is installed assistant-side. The user does not need to edit `.env.local`.
- The Web API key is a public client identifier, not a server credential. Do not add a service-account key or Admin SDK credentials.
- Authentication uses Email/Password and in-memory browser persistence. Live sign-up/password sign-in and the browser sign-in flow passed with disposable synthetic accounts, which were deleted. Do not use real staff accounts or data.
- Firestore requests are made by the Java backend through the REST API, forwarding the signed-in user's Firebase ID token. Firestore Security Rules authorize those requests; no privileged server identity bypasses the rules.
- The app uses `users/{uid}/demoEmployees`, `demoAttendance`, `demoLeaveRequests`, and `demoTickets`. Workflow documents are owner-scoped with no reviewer or delete permission in the candidate rules. The opt-in seed writes fictional employee/attendance records only.
- The user published the updated `docs/firestore.rules`. Live Firebase smoke testing with disposable accounts verified owner-scoped employee create/update, leave and ticket create/cancel/read-back, and a cross-user denial (`403`). Both disposable Auth accounts and employee documents were deleted; one cancelled synthetic leave and one cancelled synthetic ticket remain under their deleted test UIDs because workflow deletes are intentionally denied (`LV-3502C01F0E60`, `TK-F05DD2B0D6CC`). No real employee data or credentials were used. These are **development-only** rules, not production role/HR policy.

This is the shortest safe path from the current prototype to a complete **approved-scope course project**. It does not mean production payroll readiness or guessed business rules.

/** Synthetic employee-to-schedule mapping; replace with the approved source later. */
public final class InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore implements EmployeeScheduleStore {
    private final Map<String, Integer> scheduleByEmployee;

    public InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore() {
        Map<String, Integer> values = new HashMap<>();
        values.put("DEMO-001", 101);
        values.put("DEMO-002", 102);
        values.put("DEMO-003", 103);
        scheduleByEmployee = Collections.unmodifiableMap(values);
    }

    @Override
    public OptionalInt findScheduleIdForEmployee(String employeeId) {
        Integer scheduleId = employeeId == null ? null : scheduleByEmployee.get(employeeId);
        return scheduleId == null ? OptionalInt.empty() : OptionalInt.of(scheduleId);
    }

    private static String attendanceToJson(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            AttendanceRecord record = records.get(i);
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append("{\"attendanceId\":").append(record.getAttendanceId())
                .append(",\"scheduleId\":").append(record.getScheduleId())
                .append(",\"date\":\"").append(record.getDate())
                .append("\",\"timeIn\":\"").append(record.getTimeIn())
                .append("\",\"timeOut\":\"").append(record.getTimeOut())
                .append("\",\"dayType\":\"").append(escapeJson(record.getDayType())).append("\"}");
        }
        return json.append("],\"count\":").append(records.size())
            .append(",\"hoursCalculated\":false}").toString();
    }

    private void handleStaticFiles(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        boolean headOnly = "HEAD".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod());
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod()) && !headOnly) {
            sendText(exchange, 405, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Method not allowed");
            return;
        }
        String requestPath = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        if (requestPath == null || "/".equals(requestPath)) requestPath = "/index.html";
        Path requested = webRoot.resolve(requestPath.substring(1)).normalize();
        if (!requested.startsWith(webRoot) || !Files.isRegularFile(requested)) {
            sendText(exchange, 404, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Not found");
            return;
        }
        String contentType = contentTypeFor(requested);
        byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(requested);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Security-Policy",
            "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; "
                + "connect-src 'self' https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com; "
                + "object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()");
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", contentType);
        if (headOnly) {
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Length", Integer.toString(bytes.length));
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, -1);
            exchange.close();
            return;
        }
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Temporary raw attendance fixture. All entries and classifications are synthetic. */
public final class InMemoryAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final List<AttendanceRecord> records;

    public InMemoryAttendanceStore() {
        List<AttendanceRecord> values = new ArrayList<>();
        values.add(record(5001, 101, "2026-10-01", "08:01", "17:00"));
        values.add(record(5002, 101, "2026-10-02", "07:58", "16:59"));
        values.add(record(5003, 101, "2026-10-15", "08:03", "17:01"));
        values.add(record(5101, 102, "2026-10-01", "08:00", "17:02"));
        values.add(record(5102, 102, "2026-10-03", "08:04", "17:03"));
        values.add(record(5201, 103, "2026-10-02", "08:10", "16:55"));
        records = Collections.unmodifiableList(values);
        enforceUniqueScheduleDate(records);
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return records.stream()
            .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord record(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, String date, String in, String out) {
        return new AttendanceRecord(attendanceId, scheduleId, LocalDate.parse(date),
            LocalTime.parse(in), LocalTime.parse(out), "DEMO");
    }

    private static void enforceUniqueScheduleDate(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            String key = record.getScheduleId() + ":" + record.getDate();
            if (!keys.add(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate attendance for schedule/date: " + key);
        }
    }
}

function setWorkflowStatus(id, message, error = false) {
  const element = document.getElementById(id);
  element.textContent = message;
  element.classList.toggle('workflow-error', error);
  element.classList.toggle('workflow-success', Boolean(message) && !error);
}

function showAttendanceMessage(message) {
  attendanceRows.replaceChildren();
  const row = document.createElement('tr');
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  cell.colSpan = 6;
  cell.className = 'table-message';
  cell.textContent = message;
  row.append(cell);
  attendanceRows.append(row);
}

function applyDefaultAttendanceRange(records) {
  if (!records.length || attendanceFrom.value || attendanceTo.value) return;
  const dates = records.map(record => String(record.date))
    .filter(date => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date))
    .sort();
  if (!dates.length) return;
  // The legacy MO-IT108 requirement says the attendance view defaults to its full available date span.
  // This is not a pay-period calendar and does not derive hours or payroll values.
  attendanceFrom.value = dates[0];
  attendanceTo.value = dates[dates.length - 1];
}

function renderAttendance(records) {
  state.rawAttendance = records;
  document.getElementById('attendance-export-button').disabled = records.length === 0;
  applyDefaultAttendanceRange(records);
  attendanceRows.replaceChildren();
  if (records.length === 0) {
    showAttendanceMessage('No attendance entries match this employee and date range.');
  } else {
    records.forEach(record => {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      [record.date, String(record.attendanceId), String(record.scheduleId), record.timeIn, record.timeOut, record.dayType]
        .forEach(value => row.append(makeCell(value)));
      attendanceRows.append(row);
    });
  }
  attendanceResultCount.textContent = `${records.length} raw ${records.length === 1 ? 'entry' : 'entries'} loaded`;
}

  return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map(part => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
}

function makeCell(content) {
  const cell = document.createElement('td');

}
